sa: बृहस्पतिरुवाच न जातु कलहेनेच्छेन्नियन्तुमपकारिणः। बालैरासेवितं ह्येतद् यदम! यदक्षमा॥
en: One should never wish to vanquish his enemies by quarrel. Worked up with anger and shom of forgiveness, boys only seek quarrel.

sa: पूजयित्वा यथान्यायमभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः॥ प्रावेशयत् ततः कक्ष्यां द्वितीयां राजवेश्मनः।
en: Adoring him in due form and saluting him properly, with joined hands he conducted him to the first chamber of the palace.

sa: अद्य त्वां देवगन्धर्वा दिव्याश्चाप्सरसो दिवि। उपसेवन्तु कल्याण्यं विरजोऽम्बरभूषणाः॥
en: Let celestials and Gandharvas, and celestial Apsara, dressed in pure robes and beautiful ornaments, wait upon and serve you for your happiness.

sa: तदैव हि स राजेन्द्रो दुःखशोकाल्पुतोऽभवत्। यदैव वृत्तं पितरमुत्तङ्कादशृणोत्तदा॥
en: When he heard all the circumstances of his father's death from Uttanka, the king of kings was overcome with sorrow and pain.

sa: मन्त्रसंवरणे शक्ताः शक्ताः सूक्ष्मासु बुद्धिषु। नीतिशास्त्रविशेषज्ञाः सततं प्रियवादिनः॥
en: And they could keep their counsel and judge of things finely, and were well-versed in the art of policy, and ever fair-spoken.

sa: ततः प्रवृत्तं सुमहद्युद्धं युद्धविशारद॥ अनरण्यस्य नृपते राक्षसेन्द्रस्य चाद्भुतम्।
en: Then, O you proficient in fight, there took place a mighty and wonderful encounter between king Anaranya and that lord of Raksasas.

sa: बहूनि नागवेश्मानि गङ्गायास्तीर उत्तरे। तत्रस्थानपि संस्तौमि महतः पन्नगानहम्॥
en: These are many settlements of Nagas on the northern banks of the Ganges and there do I often worship the great Nagas.

sa: स तां पुनरुवाच 'नापराध्यामि, किंचिन्नावेक्षे, हवींषि नावलिह' इति॥
en: He replied, “I committed no fault. I did not lick the sacrificial ghee, I did not cast even a look at it."

sa: कुरुते पञ्चरूपाणि कालयुक्तानि यः सदा। भवत्यग्निस्तथाऽऽदित्यो मृत्युर्वैश्रवणो यमः॥
en: The king puts on five different forms according to five different occasions. He energy the becomes Agni, Aditya, Mrityu, Vaishravana, and Yama.

sa: तच्छुवा केशवस्याङ्कमगमद् रुदती तदा। सत्यभामा प्रकृपिता कोपयन्ती जनार्दनम्॥
en: Hearing the narrative, Satyabhama, giving way to anger and tears, approached Keshava, and sitting on his lap, increased his anger (for Kritavarman).

sa: उत्तङ्क देशे कालेऽभ्यागतः स्वागतं ते वत्स त्वमनागसि मया न शप्तः श्रेयस्तवोपस्थितं सिद्धिमाप्नुहीति॥
en: “Uttanka, you have come at the proper time. Welcome, my child. As you are innocent, I do not curse you. Good fortune will come to you. Let your wishes be crowned with success."

sa: दक्ष उवाच सन्ति नो बहवो रुद्राः शूलहस्ताः कपर्दिनः। एकादशस्थानगता नाहं वेद्मि महेश्वरम्॥
en: Dhaksha said-We have many Rudras armed with lances and having matted locks on their heads. They are eleven in number. I know them all, but I do not know who this Maheshvara is.

sa: स तैः क्रीडन्धनुष्मद्भिोम्नि वीरः प्रकाशते। धनुष्मद्भिर्यथा मेधैर्मारुतः प्रभुरम्बरे॥
en: That hero, playing pranks with those bowmen, appeared like the masterful Wind playing tricks with the bow-bearing clouds. (i.e. having the iris.)

sa: यस्मात् संशयितेऽप्यर्थेऽयथान्यायं प्रवर्तसे। तस्माद् योत्स्यामि सहितस्त्वया राम महाहवे॥
en: Since you act unrighteously towards me in a matter connected with profit, I shall certainly fight with you in a great battle.

sa: कर्मणा दुष्कृतेनेह स्थानाद् भ्रश्यति वै द्विजः। ज्येष्ठं वर्णमनुप्राप्य तस्माद् रक्षेद् वै द्विजः॥
en: He, however, that is born a Brahmana goes down from his status through his own evil deeds. Hence, the Brahmana, after having acquired the status of the first order, should always protect it.

sa: अकरोद् यदयं कर्म तन्नोऽर्जुनक चोदकम्। विनाशहेतुर्नान्योऽस्य वध्यतेऽयं स्वकर्मणा॥
en: There was no other cause by which this child met its death. It was killed by the result of its own Karma.

sa: बाहुभ्यामुद्वहेद् भूमि दहेत् क्रुद्ध इमाः प्रजाः। पातयेत् त्रिदिवाद् देवान् योऽर्जुनं समरे जयेत्॥
en: He, who would defeat Arjuna in battle, could bear the earth with his arms and being excited with wrath could burn up all earthy creatures, and could hurl down the gods from heaven.

sa: अवश्यं करणीयं च भवतां सुखमुत्तमम्। तस्मादुपायमाख्यास्ये सहस्राक्षो वधिष्यति॥
en: Again I am to afford excellent felicity to you. I shall say the solution by which Indra will able to slay him.

sa: स उपाध्यायं प्रत्युवाच-'अर्कपत्राणि भक्षयित्वाऽन्धीभूतोऽस्मि। अतः कूपे पत्तितः' इति॥
en: He answered to the preceptor, “I have become blind by eating the leaves of Arka tree and thus fallen into this well."

sa: गवां भवनमासाद्य तीर्थसेवी यथाक्रमम्। तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वाणो गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Going in due order to the Gobhavana and bathing in it, the pilgrim obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: सेनायास्तु तवैवास्याः कर्तुमिच्छामि भोजनम्। मम प्रीतियथारूपा त्वमर्हो मनुजर्षभ॥
en: But I wish to feast your forces. And, O best of men, it behoves you to act in harmony with my desire.

sa: स तत्र नागांस्तानस्तुवदेभिः श्लोकैः य ऐरावतराजानः सर्पाः समितिशोभनाः। क्षरन्त इव जीमूताः सविद्युत्पवनेरिताः॥
en: To please the Nagas, he uttered the following slokas, “O serpents, subjects of the king Airavata, you are brilliant in battles, you shower weapons like clouds, charged with lightning and driven by wind.

sa: पुण्योऽयमितिहासाख्यः पवित्रं चेदमुत्तमम्। कृष्णेन मुनिना विप्र निर्मितं सत्यवादिना॥
en: Called a history, it is sacred, purifying and excellent. It has been composed by the ascetic Krishna, O Brahmana, of truthful speech.

sa: इङ्गित्तेन तु तज्ज्ञात्वा गाङ्गेयेन विचिन्तितम्। दुर्योधनो महाराज दुःशासनमचोदयत्।॥
en: Coming to know from outward expressions what the son of Ganga had been thinking of, Duryodhana, O mighty monarch ordered Dushasana saying.

sa: कुन्त्युवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। विदुलायाश्च संवादं पुत्रस्य च परंतप॥
en: Kunti said In this connection is cited the old story of the conversation between Vidula and her son, O chastiser of foes.

sa: तथाश्वासय ह्रीमन्तं किंत्विदं यन्महीपतिः। वसुधासक्तनयनो मन्दमश्रूणि मुञ्चति ॥
en: Do you now console the bashful king; why has he, with his eyes steadily fixed on the ground, been shedding tears slowly?

sa: स स्त्रीषु प्राप्तकालासु पाण्डवो बालकेषु च॥ प्रतिपत्स्यति बीभत्सुर्भवतश्चौर्ध्वदेहिकम्।
en: Tile son of Pandu will do what is best for the women and the children. Even he will perform your funeral rites.

sa: तदप्रियमनाया वचनं दारुणोदयम्। श्रुत्वा गतव्यथो रामः कैकेयीं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing those cruel and unpleasant words of the wicked Kaikeyi, Rama, not being distressed, began to address her with the following words.

sa: यदयं किल्बिषाद् भेदः कृतोऽप्येवं न गृह्यते। जायते तत्र मे दुःखं धर्मसङ्गश्च गर्हितः॥
en: Here lies my sorrow that you did not admit that this disturbance of the installation has arisen out of the pretext of boon-giving; your idea of virtue is indeed an object of censure.

sa: लोकपालाः समस्तास्ते नाद्य रामाभिषेचनम्। न च कृत्स्नास्त्रयो लोका विहन्युः किं पुनः पिताः।।
en: What of the father, not even all the protectors of the regions nor the entire population of the three worlds shall be able to present any obstacle in the way of Rāma's installation.

sa: तं पार्थेनाभये दत्ते नमुचेर्धातरं मयम्। न हन्तुमैच्छद् दाशार्हः पावको न ददाह च॥
en: As the kind Partha said to Maya not to fear, the Dasharha hero (Krishna) did not desire to kill him who was the brother of Namuchi. Agni also did not burn him down.

sa: तुष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णा सा पुरी कुरुनन्दन। अशोभत तदा तेन शक्रेणेवामरावती॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, that city, full of well-fed and happy men, looked as gay as Amravati with the presence of Indra.

sa: एवं परस्परं तौ तु पथोऽर्थं वाक्यमूचतुः। अपसर्पापसर्पति वागुत्तरमकुर्वताम्॥
en: Thus they addressed each other respected their right of way. "Stand aside,” “Stand aside,” were the words they said to each other.

sa: स गत्वा गणितान्वासान्सप्ताष्टौ रघुनन्दनः। वाल्मीकाश्रममागत्य वासं चक्रे महायशाः॥
en: And having counted seven halting stations on his way, the highly illustrious descendant of Raghu, Satrughna, arrived at the hermitage of Valmiki.

sa: बद्धकक्षौ महाबाहू पौरुषे पर्यवस्थितौ। बृहन्तौ वासिताहेतोः समदाविव कुञ्जरौ॥
en: Those mighty-armed heroes girt their lions and summoned all their strength; they roared like two infuriated elephants contending (for a female elephant).

sa: तथेत्युक्त्वा तत: सूदः संस्थानं वध्यघातिनाम्। गत्वाऽऽजहार त्वरितो नरमांसमपेतभीः॥
en: Saying "Be it so," the cook went to the place where the executioners were and he soon took from them human flesh.

sa: स मया क्रीडता बाल्ये कृत्वा तार्ण भुजंगमम्। अग्निहोत्रे प्रसक्तस्तु भीषितः प्रमुमोह वै॥
en: When he was engaged in Agnihotra, out of boyish frivolity, I made a snake of the blades of grass and tried to frighten him. He fainted away (when he saw this mock snake).

sa: अथास्य पश्चाद् विदुर आचख्यौ पाण्डवान् वृतान्। सर्वान् कुशलिनो वीरान् पूजितान् द्रुपदेन ह॥
en: It was then that Vidura said that Draupadi had chosen the Pandavas for her husbands and they were all in good health and peace and those heroes had been duly received by Drupada.

sa: विष्णुना च तदाकाशे वैनतेयः समेयिवान्। तस्य नारायणस्तुष्टस्तेनालौल्येन कर्मणा॥
en: The son of Vinata then saw Vishnu on his way in the sky and Narayana was pleased with him for his self-denial.

sa: आहूतो विद्यया भद्रे भार्गवेण महात्मना। त्वत्समीपमिहायातः कथंचित् समजीवितः॥
en: "O amiable lady, summoned by the illustrious Bhargava (your father), I have somehow or other come before you having been made alive."

sa: कृते विवाहे द्रुपदो धनं ददौ महारथेभ्यो बहुरूपसमुत्तमम्। शतं रथानां वरहेममालिनां चतुर्युजां हेमखलीनमालिनाम्॥
en: After the wedding was over, Drupada gave to those great car-warriors various kind of excellent wealth. (He gave them) one hundred chariots with golden standards, each drawn by four horses with golden bridles;

sa: तथा दिव्यानि चास्त्राणि निखिलेनाहरिष्यति। विप्रणष्टां श्रियं चायमाहर्ता पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: He will also acquire all kinds of celestial weapons and this best of men will retrieve the lost fortunes of his race."

sa: अद्य गात्राणि ते कङ्काः श्येना गोमायवस्तथा। कर्षन्तु भुवि संहृष्टा निहतस्य मया मृधे॥
en: As if pressed by the trend of a mighty elephant. When you will be killed by me in battle your body will be to day torn by hawks, herons and jackals, in glee.

sa: ते तत्र द्रौपदी लब्ध्वा परिसंवत्सरोषिताः। विदिता हास्तिनपुरं प्रत्याजग्मुररिंदमाः॥
en: Having obtained Draupadi, they lived there for a year. And then those chastisers of foes, having been known, went back to Hastinapur.

sa: ययातिरुवाच यत् त्वं मे हृदयाजातो वयः स्वं न प्रयच्छसि। जरादोषस्त्वया प्रोक्तस्तस्मात् त्वं प्रतिपत्स्यसे॥ प्रजाश्च यौवनप्राप्ता विनाशिष्यन्त्यनो तव। अग्निप्रस्कन्दनपरस्त्वं चाप्येर्वं भविष्यसि॥
en: Yayati said : O son, you have sprung from my heart, but you do not give me your youth. As you find so many faults with decrepitude, decrepitude will overcome you. Your sons will die as soon as they will attain to their youth. You shall not be able to perform any sacrifice before fire.

sa: स निर्याय महाबाहुः पुण्डरीकेक्षणस्ततः। गिरिव्रजाद् बहिस्तस्थौ समदेशे महायशाः॥
en: The long armed, the lotus-eyed and the greatly famous (Krishna), coming out (of Girivraja), stopped on a level plain outside the city.

sa: ततस्तु वरयित्वा तामानीय भरतर्षभः। विवाहं कारयामास विदुरस्य महामतेः॥
en: The best of the Bharata race (Bhishma) brought her from her father's abode and he married her to the high minded Vidura.

sa: तेनाहं प्रेषिता भ्रात्रा दुष्टभावेन रक्षसा। बिभक्षयिषता मांसं युष्माकममरोपम॥
en: O celestial like man, I have been sent here by my brother, that Rakshasas, with the cruel intention of eating your flesh.

sa: सैवमुक्ताब्रवीत् कन्या देवं वरदमीश्वरम्। पतिं सर्वगुणोपेतमिच्छामीति पुनः पुनः॥
en: Having been thus addressed, she repeatedly said to the boon-giving supreme lord, "I desire to have a husband endued with all accomplishments."

sa: न करिष्यसि चेदेवं मृतां मामुपधारय। प्राणदानान्महाबाहो चर धर्ममनुत्तमम्॥
en: If you do not accept me know that I will destroy myself. O mighty-armed hero, earn great merit by saving my life.

sa: तान् पूर्वेन्द्रानभिवीक्ष्याभिरूपान् शक्रात्मजं चेन्द्ररूपं निशम्य। प्रीतो राजा दुपदो विस्मितश्च दिव्यां मायां तामवेक्ष्याप्रमेयाम्॥
en: Seeing the (four others) Pandavas in the forms of the (present) Indra sprang from Indra himself, the king Drupada was exceedingly pleased. He was greatly surprised on seeing the celestial manifestation of Maya.

sa: यदाश्रौषं विविधांश्चित्रमार्गान् गदायुद्धे मण्डलशश्चरन्तम्। मिथ्या हतं वासुदेवस्य बुद्ध्या तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that while displaying various modes of atiаck and defence in a club-fight, he had been unjustly slain through the counsels of Krishna.

sa: अष्टौ दंष्ट्राः सुतीक्ष्णाग्राश्चिरस्यापातदुस्सहाः। देहेषु मज्जयिष्यामि स्निग्धेषु पिशितेषु च।॥
en: My eight teeth are sharp pointed and incapable of being resisted by anything. I shall dip them into the most delicious meat.

sa: श्राद्धपर्व ततो ज्ञेयं कुरूणामौर्ध्वदेहिकम्। चार्वाकनिग्रहः पर्व रक्षसो ब्रह्मरूपिणः॥
en: Then Shraddha Parva, describing the funeral rites for the killed Kurus; then Charvaka-vadha who was a Rakshasa but appeared as a Brahmana.

sa: दृष्ट्वा भीमबलोद्भूतं बकं विनिहतं तदा। ज्ञातयोऽस्य भयोद्विग्नाः प्रतिजग्मुस्ततस्ततः॥
en: Seeing Baka killed by Bhima and his extraordinary strength, the kinsmen (of the Rakshasas) became frightened and ran away in different directions.

sa: सर्वातिक्रान्तमर्यादं पृष्ठभङ्गं च चक्रतुः। सम्पूर्णमूर्छा बाहुभ्यां पूणकुम्भं प्रचक्रतुः॥
en: They then performed the grandest of all feats in wrestling namely Prishthabhanga, they also performed the feats, called Sampurva Nemcha and Purnakumbha.

sa: हिरण्यबिन्दोस्तीर्थे च स्नात्वा पुरुषसत्तमः। दृष्टवान् पाण्डवश्रेष्ठः पुण्यान्यायतनानि च॥
en: That best of then bathed at the pilgrimage, named, Hiranyabindu and then that best of Pandavas went to many other sacred pieces.

sa: तमाश्रमं महातेजाः पिता ते सुमहायशाः। पुरोहितं महात्मानं दिदृक्षुरगमत्स्वयम्॥
en: At that time your sire, the highly effulgent and illustrious Dasaratha, with a view to see his high-souled priest Vasistha, repaired there.

sa: यदा न कुरुते पापं सर्वभूतेषु कर्हिचित्। कर्मणा मनसा वाचा ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा॥
en: It is only when a man does not commit a sin in thought, deed or word in respect of any living creatures, it is then that he attains to the purity of Brahma.

sa: वयं हि क्षत्रिया राजन् पाण्डोः पुत्रा महात्मनः। ज्येष्ठं मां विद्धि कौन्तेयं भीसेनार्जुनाविमौ॥
en: O king, we are Kshatriyas and we are the sons of the illustrious Pandu. Know me to be the eldest of the sons of Kunti and these two to be Bhima and Arjuna.

sa: अध्ययोजनं गत्वा नदी पश्चान्मुखाश्रिताम्। सरयूं पुण्यसलिलां ददर्श रघुनन्दनः॥
en: Having thus gone for more than a half Yojana, the descendant of Raghu, espied Şurayū of holy waters flowing towards the west.

sa: वैशंपायन उवाच रहस्यं खल्विदं राजन्देवानामिति नः श्रुतम्। तत्तु ते कथयिष्यामि नमस्कृत्वा स्वयंभुवे॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, we have heard that what you ask is a mystery even to the celestials. I shall however, speak of it, after bowing my head to the Self-Born (Brahma).

sa: तस्यामजनयत् पुत्रं राजानं बभ्रुवाहनम्। तं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवो राजंश्चित्रवाहनमब्रवीत्॥
en: He saw there on the throne Babhruvahana, begotten by him (on Chitrangada). Seeing her, O king, the Pandava (Arjuna) said to Chitravahana.

sa: प्रतिगृह्यार्जुनः सर्वमुपभुज्य च पाण्डवः। सहैव वासुदेवेन दृष्ट्वान् नटनर्तकान्॥ अभ्यनुज्ञाय तान् सर्वानर्चयित्वा च पाण्डवः। सत्कृतं शयनं दिव्यमभ्यगच्छन्महामतिः॥
en: Enjoying every thing that was provided there for him, the Pandava Arjuna sat with Vasudeva (Krishna) to see the performances of the actors and dancers. Having dismissed them all with proper respect, the high-souled Pandavas laid himself down on a well-adorned and excellent bed.

sa: अलंकृता द्वारका तु बभूव जनमेजय। कुन्तीपुत्रस्य पूजार्थमपि निष्कुटकेष्वपि॥
en: O Janamejaya, Dwarka with its streets, gardens and houses was well adorned to give a grand reception to the son of Kunti.

sa: अथैनामार्तवैः पुष्पैर्गन्धैश्च विविधैर्वरैः। शिविकां तामलंकृत्य वाससाऽच्छाद्य सर्वशः॥ तां तथा शोभितां माल्यैर्वासोभिश्च महाधनैः। अमात्या ज्ञातयश्चैनं सुहृदश्चोपतस्थिरे॥ नृसिंहं नरयुक्तेन परमालंकृतेन तम्। अवहन् यानमुख्येन सह माया सुसंयतम्॥
en: Friends, relatives and adherents, wrapping it up with cloth, decked the body of the king with the flowers of the season and sprinkled over it various perfumes. They decked the hearse also with garlands and rich hangings. Then placing the bodies of the king and the queen on the excellent heir, decked out so brightly, they caused it to be carried on the shoulders of men.

sa: रेतत्सत्यं काममेवं वरं ते। प्रीत्या युक्ताः कामितं सर्वशस्ते कर्तारः स्म प्रवणा भागिनेय॥
en: They said in joy, "O nephew, as regards the boon asked by you, let it be exactly as you say. O nephew, we shall all cheerfully do what you ask us to do.

sa: त्रिभिर्भवद्भिर्हि विना नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे। धर्मकामार्थरहितो रोगात इव दुःखितः॥
en: Like a sorrowful man afflicted with disease and like a man without Dharma, Artha and Kama, I dare not live without you.

sa: प्रवेशयत संभारान्माभूत्कालात्ययो यथा। अद्यैवाहं गमिष्यामि लक्ष्मणेन गतां गतिम्॥
en: Do you, without any delay collect there all articles of installation. I shall follow the way which has been wended by Lakşmaņa.

sa: तस्यागमनसंहृष्टः सामात्यः पुरःसरः। सभार्य: सह पुत्रेण निर्जगाम बृहद्रथः॥
en: Being overjoyed at the arrival of the Rishi, Brihadratha with his ministers, priest, his son and wives went out to receive him.

sa: तां तु तेजस्विनी कन्यां रूपयौवनशालिनीम्। व्यवृण्वन्पार्थिवाः केचिदतीव स्त्रीगुणैर्युताम्॥
en: But through the maiden was effulgent and possessed beauty and all womanly qualifications and youth, yet no king sought for her hand.

sa: विदुरच महाप्राज्ञस्तथान्ये कुरुपुङ्गवाः। पौराश्च पुरुषव्याघ्रानन्वीयुः शोककर्शिताः॥ तत्र केचिद् ब्रुवन्ति स्म ब्राह्मणा निर्भयास्तदा। दीनान् दृष्ट्वा पाण्डुसुतानतीव भृशदुःखिताः॥
en: The greatly intelligent Vidura and other best of the Kurus and also the citizens followed these best of men (for some distance) in sorrow. Seeing the sons of Pandu affected with sorrow and in grief, some of the men of the city spoke thus-

sa: तत्र तत्र महानादैरुत्कृष्टतलनादितैः। हृष्टं प्रमुदितं सर्वं दैत्यानामभवत् पुरम्॥
en: Here and there arose loud uproars of merriment, mixed with the clapping of hands which filled the city of those two Danavas.

sa: नलोपाख्यानमत्रैव धर्मिष्ठं करुणोदयम्। दमयन्त्याः स्थितिर्यत्र नलस्य चरितं तथा॥
en: It then contains the holy and most pathetic story of Nala, illustrating the great patience of Damayanti and the character of Nala.

sa: कर्णस्य परिमोक्षोऽत्र कुण्डलाभ्यां पुरन्दरात्। तथा यज्ञविभूतिश्च गयस्यात्र प्रकीर्तिता॥
en: Then it relates the account of the deprivation of Karna of his "ear-rings" by Indra and then the sacrificial greatness by Gaya;

sa: उल्मुकं भ्रामयंस्तूर्णं पाण्डवश्चर्म चोत्तरम्। व्यपोहत शरांस्तस्य सर्वानेव धनंजयः॥
en: The Pandava Dhananjaya, who had an excellent shield, warded off all those arrows with it and with the torch in his hand.

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणे काकुत्स्थे क्रोधशोकसमन्विते। ब्रह्मा सुरगणैः सार्धमुवाच रघुनन्दनम्॥
en: Rāma, having given vent to those accents under the influence of ire, the patriarch Brahmā, with the consent of the celestials, said.

sa: प्रवीरेश्वररौद्राश्वास्त्रयः पुत्रा महारथाः। पूरोः पौष्ट्यामजायन्त प्रवीरो वंशकृत् ततः॥
en: Puru begot on his wife Paushti three great car-warriors, namely Pravira, Ishvara and Raudrashva. Amongst these three, Pravira kept up the line.

sa: तेजसा सूर्यसंकाशः क्षमया पृथिवीसमः। यमान्तकसमः क्रोधे श्रिया वैश्रवणोयमः॥
en: He was like Surya in glory, like earth in patience, like the destroyer Yama in anger and like Vaishravana (Kubera) in wealth.

sa: विद्याधराधिपश्चैव चक्रधर्मा सहानुजैः॥ उपाचरति तत्र स्म धनानामीश्वरं प्रभुम्॥
en: Wait there upon the lord, the aster of wealth, Hundreds and thousands of Kinnaras wait upon the lord, the inaster of wealth.

sa: पाण्डुरुवाच अद्यैव त्वं वरारोहे प्रयतस्व यथाविधि। धर्ममावाहय शुभे स हि लोकेषु पुण्यभाक्॥
en: Pandu said : O beautiful lady, O amiable one try to do it today in the proper form. Call Dharma (the god of justice), for he is the most virtuous in the world.

sa: अन्वम्भानुप्रभृतयो मिश्रकेश्यां मनस्विनः। रौद्राश्वस्य महेष्वासा दशाप्सरसि सूनवः॥ यज्वानो जज्ञिरे शूराः प्रजावन्तो बहुश्रुताः। सर्वे सर्वास्त्रविद्वांसः सर्वे धर्मपरायणाः॥
en: The wise and virtuous Raudrashva begoi on Apsara Mishrakeshi ten sons who were all great bow-men. They were great heroes and performed many sacrifices in honour of the celestial; they were learned in all the Shastras and were virtuous. All of them begot sons.

sa: नाभवन् दस्यवः केचिन्नाधर्मरुचयो जनाः। प्रदेशेष्वपि राष्ट्राणां कृतं युगमवर्तत॥
en: There were no thieves, there was none who was sinful. It seemed that Satyayuga had come over all parts of the kingdom.

sa: द्रौपद्याः कीर्तितश्चात्र संवादः सत्यभामया। पुनद्वैतवनं चैव पाण्डवाः समुपागताः॥
en: Then is told the meeting of Draupadi and Satyabhama nd their conversation, the return of the Pandavas to the forest of Dvaita;

sa: बाढमित्यब्रवीद्रामस्तौ चानुज्ञाप्य राघवौ। प्रहृष्टौ जग्मतुः स्थानं यत्रास्ते मुनिपुङ्गवः॥
en: Saying 'so it shall be' Rama bade them adieu and they too, delighted, repaired to where Vālmīki, the foremost of Munis was.

sa: सिन्धोर्नदस्य महतो निकुञ्जे न्यवसत् तदा। नदीविषयपर्यन्ते पर्वतस्य समीपतः॥
en: He took shelter in the forest on the banks of the river Sindhu which extended up to the foot of the mountain.

sa: अथ त्विदं प्रवक्ष्यामि धर्मतत्त्वं निबोध मे। पुराणमृषिभिईष्टं धर्मविद्भिर्महात्मभिः॥
en: But I shall tell you the religious precepts which the illustrious Rishis, learned in the precepts of virtue, said in the Puranas.

sa: ततः स्वैर्भूषणैर्दासी भूषयित्वाप्सरोपमाम्। प्रेषयामास कृष्णाय ततः काशिपतेः सुता॥
en: Having decked a maid-servant like an Apsara with her ornaments. The daughter of the king of Kashi sent her to Krishna (Vyasa).

sa: आस्तीक उवाच सोमस्य यज्ञो वरुणस्य यज्ञः प्रजापतेर्यज्ञ आसीत्प्रयागे। तथा यज्ञोऽयं तव भारतार्थ्य पारिक्षित स्वस्ति नोऽस्तु प्रियेभ्यः॥
en: Astika said: O son of Parikshit, О best of the Bharata race, Soma, Varuna and Prajapati performed sacrifices at Prayaga in the days of yore, but your sacrifice, is in no way inferior to them. Blessing be upon those who are dear to us!

sa: वैशंपायन उवाच ब्रह्मणो मानसाः पुत्रा विदिताः षण्महर्षयः। एकादश सुता: स्थाणोः ख्याता: परमतेजसः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : It is known that the mind-born sons of Brahma were six great Rishis. There was another (mind-borm son of Brahma,) named Sthanu. He had eleven sons gifted with great energy,

sa: इत्येषा मे मती राजन् यथा वा मन्यसेऽनघ। एवंगते ममाचक्ष्व स्वयं निश्चित्य हेतुभिः॥
en: O king, O sinless one, this is my opinion. Do as you think (proper)after reflecting over everything, nothing the causes and effects of all. Tell us what you yourself think proper to do.

sa: दर्शयन् सर्वसैन्यानां स बाह्वोर्बलमात्मनः। सिंहनादस्वनं कृत्वा निर्जगाम धनंजयः॥
en: Showing the prowess of arms to all the hosts, Dhananjaya (Arjuna), sending forth a leonine shout, came out of the Panchala ranks).

sa: त्रयस्त्वङ्गिरसः पुत्रा लोके सर्वत्र विश्रुताः। बृहस्पतिरुतथ्यश्च संवर्तश्च धृतव्रताः॥
en: It is well-known in the world that the sons of Angiras were three, namely Brihaspati, Utathya and Samvarta, all of great asceticism.

sa: केचिदासन् विमनसः केचिदासन् मुदान्विताः। आहुः परस्परं केचिन्निपुणा बुद्धिजीविनः॥
en: While some of them were pleased, others were displeased and some among them possessing intelligence and foresight talked to one another thus,

sa: अहं त्वां मोक्षयिष्यामि वासुके पन्नगोत्तम। तस्माच्छापान्महासत्त्व सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: "O Vasuki, the best of snakes, I shall protect you, I tell you truly that I shall relieve you from the curse.

sa: वर्तमाने तथाभूते यज्ञे च परमाद्भुते। सशिष्य आजगामाशु वाल्मीकिर्भगवानृपिः॥
en: That sacrifice, the like of which was never seen before, having been undertaken the illustrious ascetic Valmiki, with his disciples, came there.

sa: सिंहौ भूत्वा पुनर्व्याघ्रौ पुनश्चान्तर्हितावुभौ। तैस्तैरुपायैस्तौ क्रूरावृषीन् दृष्ट्वा निजजतुः॥
en: Sometimes they became lions, sometimes tigers and sometime, they disappeared. By assuming such forms, they killed the Rishis wherever they saw them.

sa: तत्र यदोर्यादवाः पूरोः पौरवाः॥
en: From Yadu, the Yadavas were descended and from Puru and Pauravas.

sa: प्रवृत्तिस्तत्र चाख्याता यत्र भीमस्य लुब्धकैः। क्षेपयुक्तैर्वचोभिश्च धर्मराजस्य धीमतः॥ ह्रदात्समुत्थितो यत्र धार्तराष्ट्रोऽत्यमर्षणः। भीमेन गदया युद्धं यत्रासौ कृतवान्सह॥
en: The receipt of this news by Bhima from some hunters. Then is related how Duryodhana, ever unable to bear affronts, came out of the water, being angered by the insulting words of Yudhishthira. Then is described the fight of Bhima and Duryodhana with clubs.

sa: ऋचो बह्वचमुख्यैश्च प्रेर्यमाणाः पदक्रमैः। शुश्राव मनुजव्याघ्रो विततेष्विह कर्मसु॥
en: That best of men heard in one place the chanting of the Rigveda with the proper intention by the best of Brahmanas.

sa: सम्प्रासयौवनं दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरं धीमतां वरः। भीष्मो विचित्रवीर्यस्य विवाहायाकरोन्मतिम्॥
en: When that best of all intelligent men, Bhishma, saw that his brother Vichitravirya, had attained majority (youth), he thought of marrying him.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तास्तु राजीवलोचन। इदमूचुर्वचः काले धर्मराज युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said O lotus-eyed hero, having been thus asked by the king, they thus spoke to the Dharmaraja Yudhishthira at that time.

sa: वृष्णयश्चान्धकाश्चैव नानादेश्याश्च पार्थिवाः। सूतपुत्रश्च राधेयो गुरुं द्रोणमियात् तदा॥
en: The Vrishnis, the Andhakas and the princes from various countries and the son of Suta and Radha (Karna) made Drona their preceptor.

sa: स्वाध्यायवन्तः शुचयो मधुराः प्रियवादिनः। आनूपूर्येण सम्प्राप्ताः पञ्चालान् पाण्डुनन्दनाः॥
en: The sons of Pandu, devoted in study, amiable, sweet-speeched and pure in acts, at last arrived in the country of the Panchalas.

sa: तया बद्धमनुश्चक्षुः पाशैर्गुणमयैस्तदा। न चचाल ततो देशाद् बुबुधे न च किंचन॥ अस्या नूनं विशालाक्ष्याः सदेवासुरमानुषम्। लोकं निर्मथ्य धात्रेदं रूपमाविष्कृतं कृतम्॥
en: (He thought) “The creator has created the beauty of this beautiful eyed maiden after churning the whole world of the Devas and the Asuras and the human beings." The king's heart and eyes were captivated by that maiden, as if they became bound in ropes; he remained rooted to the spot deprived of his senses.

sa: यदाश्रौषं धनुरायम्य चित्रं विद्धं लक्ष्यं पतितं वै पृथिव्याम्। कृष्णां हृतां प्रेक्षतां सर्वराज्ञा तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Arjuna, having bent the bow, had pierced the mark and brought it to the ground and had carried away the princes Krishnaa (Draupadi) in the presence of the assembled chiefs and potentates.

sa: सर्वमेव न तत्रासीद् धर्मनित्ये युधिष्ठिरे। दस्युभ्यो वञ्चकेभ्यश्च राज्ञः प्रति परस्परम्॥ राजवल्लभतश्चैव नाश्रूयत मृषा कृतम्। प्रियं कर्तुमुपस्थातुं बलिकर्म स्वकर्मजम्॥ अभिहर्तुं नृपाः षट्सु पृथग् जात्यैश्च नैगमैः। ववृधे विषयस्तत्र धर्मनित्ये युधिष्ठिरे॥
en: In consequence of Yudhishthira being ever devoted to virtue, it was never heard that thieves or cheats or royal favourites did not wrong towards one another. In consequence of Yudhishthira's devotion to virtue his tributary chiefs always waited upon him to render him good service on the six occasions (of war, treaty etc.); and the traders and merchants of different classes paid him their dues taxes liveable on their respective trades. Thus the kingdom grew in prosperity.

sa: ददर्श विपुलश्रोणी तामेवाभिमुखे स्थिताम्। अथ तामसितापाङ्गीमाबभाषे स पार्थिवः॥
en: The king (opening his eyes) saw before him that maiden of swelling hips. The king then addressed that black eyed maiden thus,

sa: सर्वराक्षससत्राय सम्भृतं पावकं तदा। उत्तरे हिमवत्पार्श्वे उत्ससर्ज महावने॥
en: He (Parashara) threw away the fire that was kindled for the Rakshasas-sacrifice into the great forest on the north of the Himalayas.

sa: एवं शप्त्वा ततः पुत्रो विनतामन्तरिक्षगः। अरुणो दृश्यते ब्रह्मन्प्रभातसमये यदा॥ आदित्यरथमध्यास्ते सारथ्यं समकल्पयत्। गरुडोऽपि यथाकालं जज्ञे पन्नगभोजनः॥
en: Thus cursing his mother Vinata, the child rose to the sky. O Brahmana, Aruna (this child) became the charioteer of the Sun and he is to be seen in the hour of the morning. At the stipulated time was also born the snake-eater Garuda.

sa: एतदृष्टं श्रुतं चापि यथावन्नृपसत्तम। अस्माभिर्निखिलं सर्वं कथितं तेऽतिदारुणम्॥
en: O best of kings, we have told you all that we saw and heard, though the account is te: ible and cruel.

sa: यदाश्रौषं सत्कृतां मत्स्यराज्ञा सुतां दत्तामुत्तरामर्जुनाया तां चार्जुनः प्रत्यगृह्णत्सुतार्थे तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that king of Matsya (Virata) had offered his virtuous daughter Uttara to Arjuna and Arjuna had accepted her for his son Abhimanyu.

sa: एकलव्यस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणमायान्तमन्तिकात्। अभिगम्योपसंगृह्य जगाम शिरसा महीम्॥
en: Seeing Drona coming towards him, Ekalavya also went a few steps forward and touched his feet and prostrated himself on the ground.

sa: तस्यां देवेश्वरः पार्थ सभायां परमासने। आस्ते शच्या महेन्द्राण्या श्रिया लक्ष्म्या च भारत॥४।
en: O son of Pritha, O descendant of Bharata, in that Sabha sits on an excellent seat the lord of the celestialss with his wife Sachi who is the embodiment of beauty and wealth.

sa: तमब्रवीन्मन्दपाल: प्राञ्जलिहव्यवाहनम्। प्रदहन् खाण्डवं दावं मम पुत्रान् विसर्जय॥
en: Thereupon Mandapala with joined hands said to the carrier of sacrificial ghee fire, "When you will burn the Khandava, spare my sons."

sa: प्राणाधिकं भीमसेनं कृतविद्यं धनंजयम्। धार्तराष्ट्रा दुरात्मानो नामृष्यन्त परस्परम्॥
en: The wicked minded sons of Dhritarashtra became jealous of Bhima, for he was exceeding strong and of Arjuna, because he was accomplished.

sa: यश्चाहं मन्युजो मेऽग्निर्लोकानादातुमिच्छति। दहेदेष च मामेव निगृहीतः स्वतेजसा॥
en: The fire of my wrath, which is ready to consume the worlds, if suppressed, will certainly consume me by its own energy.

sa: व्यायामकर्शितः सोऽथ मृगलिप्सुः पिपासितः। आजगाम नरश्रेष्ठ वसिष्ठस्याश्रमं प्रति॥
en: Being (one day) fatigued and thirsty by the exercise of the hunt that best of men, came to the hermitage of Vasishtha.

sa: कच्चित् कृतं विजानीषे कर्तारं च प्रशंससि। सतां मध्ये महाराज सत्करोषि च पूजयन्॥
en: O great king, do you examine the works done for you? Do you praise before good men those that are employed by you? Do you reward them after showing towards them due respect?

sa: किं क्षेपैर्दुर्बलायासैः शरैः कथय भारत। गुरोः समक्षं यावत् ते हराम्यद्य शिरः शरैः॥
en: o descendant of Bharata, what need is their of altercation which is the habit of the weak! Speak in arrows, until I cut off your head today in the presence of the preceptor.

sa: कच्चित् क्रतूनेकचित्तो वाजपेयांश्च सर्वशः। पुण्डरीकांश्च कात्स्येन यतसे कर्तुमात्मवान्॥
en: With steadiness of mind and with complete self-possession, do you try to perform Vajpeya, Pundarikas and other sacrifices with all necessary rites?

sa: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः। भयकारणमाचष्ट देवानामभयंकरः॥ उवाच मधुरां वाणीं शृणुध्वं सर्वदेवताः। वधाय लवणस्याजौ शरः शत्रुघ्नदारितः॥
en: Hearing those words the Patriarch Brahmă replied Although it is a source of great fear still it is not dreadful to the celestials. There upon with sweet accents he said:-Hear, O you celestials, ſatrughna has taken up this arrow for the destruction of Pavana.

sa: चढूंषि प्रतिलस्वा च प्रतिजग्मुस्ततो नृपाः। भार्गवस्तु मुनिमेने सर्वलोकपराभवम्॥
en: Regaining their eye-sight, the kings returned to their homes) and that descendant of Bhrigu resolved in his mind to overcome the world.

sa: कशाग्रदण्डाभिहता काल्यमाना ततस्ततः। क्रोधरक्तेक्षणा क्रोधं भूय एव समादद॥
en: Afflicted with their stripes and being dragged hither and thither, her anger (doubly) ! increased and her eyes became red in wrath.

sa: क्रोशमानं भयोद्विग्नं त्रातारं नाध्यगच्छत। दृष्ट्वा तन्महदाश्चर्यं ब्रह्मतेजोभवे तदा॥
en: Becoming panic-stricken, cried aloud and did see none who could protect them. Seeing this great and wonderful feat of the Brahma might,

sa: विश्वामित्रः क्षत्रभावानिर्विण्णो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। धिग् बलं क्षत्रियबलं ब्रह्मतेजोबलं बलम्॥
en: Vishvamitra become disgusted with the Kshatriya might and spoke thus, "Fie on the Kshatriya prowess? The Brahma might is the true might.

sa: ऊरुणैकेन वामोरुर्भर्तुः कुलविवृद्धये। तद् गर्भमुपलभ्याशु ब्राह्मणी या भयार्दिता॥
en: A Brahmana woman came to know this fact and she went to the Kshatriyas and out of fear reported it to thein.

sa: तथाहतस्ततश्च त्वं दृष्टिं स्वां प्रतिमुञ्चसि। मत्पक्षप्रतिघाताय स्वपक्षोद्भावनाय च॥
en: By loO king thus towards all these meritorious Brahmanas, it is clear that you wish to humiliate them all the glorify yourself.

sa: न गृहं गृहमित्याहुहिणी गृहमुच्यते। गृहं तु गृहिणीहीनमरण्यसदृशं मतम्॥
en: One's house is not his home; one's wife only is his home. a house without the wife is desolate like a forest.

sa: गृध्र उवाच अयं प्रेतसमाकीर्णो यक्षराक्षससेवितः। दारुणः काननोद्देशः कौशिकैरभिनादितः॥
en: Dreadful is that spot, this wilderness, which resounds with the screams of owls and is filled with spirits and Yakshas and Rakshasas.

sa: गृहानुत्सृज्य यो राजन् मोक्षमेवाभिपद्यते। लोकास्तेजोमयास्तस्य कल्पन्ते शाश्वतीः समाः॥
en: O king, many bright worlds await him for eternal enjoyment, who renouncing his domestic life, adopts the religious course of emancipation. acts,

sa: यथातत्त्वं क्षितिपते तदिहैकमनाः शृणु। लोभात् क्रोधः प्रभवति परदोषैरुदीर्यते॥
en: Anger originates from covetousness. It is strengthened by the shortcomings of others. Through forgiveness it lies dormant, and through forgiveness it disappears.

sa: दानवानां शरीरैश्च पतितैः शोणितोक्षितैः॥ समाकीर्णा महाबाहो शैलैरिव सकिंशुकैः।
en: Covered with the fallen bodies of Danavas bathed in blood, the Earth looked as if overspread with mountain summits filled with Kinshukas.

sa: तानागतान् द्विजश्रेष्ठान् विरूपाक्षो विशाम्पते। यथार्ह प्रतिजग्राह विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥
en: The Rakshasa king Virupaksha, O monarch, received the guests, as they came, duly and according to the rites sanctioned in the scriptures.

sa: बोध्य उवाच उपदेशेन वर्तामि नानुशास्मीह कंचन। लक्षणं तस्य वक्ष्येऽहं तत् स्वयं परिमृश्यताम्॥
en: Vodhya said I follow the principles of others and never thrust inyself as an instructor. I shall, however, give you the outlines of those principles. Reflection will enable you to catch their spirit.

sa: अकार्यमिति चैवेमं नात्मानं संत्यजाम्यहम्। नातः पापीयसी योनि पतेयमपरामिति॥
en: I do not renounce life because it is a very sinful act, and lest, indeed, I may have a more miserable birth.

sa: समुन्नमग्रतो वस्त्रं पश्चाच्छुध्यति कर्मणा। उपवासैः प्रतप्तानां दीर्घं सुखमनन्तकम्॥
en: Washed in water a piece of cloth becomes clean. Likewise, men, repenting (for their past misdeeds), get eternal happiness by proper penances.

sa: प्रयाति संहिताध्यायी ब्रह्माणं परमेष्ठिनम्। अथबाग्नि समायाति सूर्यमाविशतेऽपि वा॥
en: A Reciter of Gayatri goes to the supreme god Brahiman, or to Agni or enters the regions, that a Reciter may acquire.

sa: ब्रह्मानुससृजे पुत्रान् मानसान् दक्षसप्तमान्। मरीचिमत्र्यङ्गिरसं पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम्॥
en: After this, Brahman, created, by his will, seven sons with Daksha at their head. They were Marichi, Atri, Angiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu.

sa: अविद्यां क्षेत्रमाहुर्हि कर्म बीजं तथा कृतम्। तृष्णा संजननं स्नेह एष तेषां पुनर्भवः॥
en: They say that Ignorance is the soil. Acts form the seed that is placed in that soil. Desire is the water that causes that seed to grow. In this manner they explained re-birth.

sa: जनक उवाच भगवन् यदि न प्रेत्य संज्ञा भवति कस्यचित्। एवं सति किमज्ञानं ज्ञानं वा किं करिष्यति॥
en: O illustrious one, if no person, retains any knowledge after departing from this state of existence, if, indeed, this is true, what then is the difference between Ignorance and Knowledge? What do we gain then by knowledge and what do we lose by ignorance?

sa: तत्र विज्ञानसंयुक्ता त्रिविधा चेतना ध्रुवा। सुखदुःखेति यामाहुरदुःखामसुखेति च॥
en: The mind, which is as an attribute of Chit, has three states, viz., pleasure, pain and absence of both pleasure and pain.

sa: देवताभ्यः पितृभ्यश्च भृत्येभ्योऽतिथिभिः सह। अवशिष्टं तु योऽश्नाति तमाहुर्विघसाशिनम्॥
en: He is said to live upon sacrificial residue who eats only what remains after feeding the gods, the Pitris, servants and guests.

sa: यावदस्य भवत्यस्मिन् कीर्तिर्लोके यशस्करी! तावत् पुण्यकृता लोकाननन्तान् पुरुषोऽश्नुते॥
en: Truly, a person enjoys endless regions of the righteous as long as his deeds or the memory thereof exists in this world.

sa: सावित्री कुण्डले दिव्ये शरीरं जनमेजयः। ब्राह्मणार्थं परित्यज्य जग्मतुलॊज्ञकमुत्तमम्॥
en: By giving away her ear-rings, Savitri, and, by giving away his own body, king Janamejaya both proceeded to high regions of felicity.

sa: सर्वरत्नं वृषादर्भिर्युवनाश्वः प्रियाः स्त्रियः। रम्यमावसथं चैव दत्वा स्वर्लोकमास्थितः॥
en: By giving away various kinds of gems, a fine palace, and inany beautiful women, Yuvanashva the son of Vrishadabha ascended to heaven.

sa: भगवन्मम वंशस्य शूलमेतदनुत्तमम्। भवेत्तु सततं देव सुराणामीश्वरो ह्यसि॥
en: O reverend one, may this excellent dart be the possession of my family O god, you are the lord of the immortals.

sa: तत्र वायुजलाहारा चचार नियम पुनः। ततो ययौ महाभागा गङ्गां मेरुं च केवलम्॥
en: There she began to pass her days observing another vow, living upon only water and air. After this, O king, the blessed maiden proceeded to the Ganges and thence to the mount Meru.

sa: सर्वेषा त्वं प्राणिनामन्तकाले कामक्रोधौ सहितौ योजयेथाः। एवं धर्मस्त्वामुपैष्यत्यमेयो न चाधर्मं लप्स्यसे तुल्यवृत्तिः॥
en: When the end of living creatures arrives you will send Desire and Anger together against them. You shall reap immeasurable merit. You will not commit sin, being yourself perfectly equal in your conduct.

sa: अतिरिक्तैः संविभजेद् भोगैरन्यानकिंचनान्। एतस्मात् कारणाद् धात्रा कुसीदं सम्प्रवर्तितम्॥
en: With his surplus riches he should remove the wants of the poor. Therefore the Creator ordained the practice of multiplying one's wealth.

sa: कदाचिन्मासमात्रेण समुत्पत्य विहङ्गमाः। नैवागच्छंस्ततो राजन् प्रातिष्ठत स जाजलिः॥
en: At last, at another time, leaving him, they did not come even after a month. Then, O king, Jajali left that place.

sa: भूमिं भूमिशयांश्चैव हन्ति काष्ठमयोमुखम्। तथैवानडुहो युक्तान् समवेक्षस्व जाजले॥
en: The iron plough wounds the soil and many creatures which live there. Look, O Jajali, at those bullocks yoked to the plough.

sa: समौ तावपि मे स्यातां न हि मेऽस्ति प्रियाप्रियम्। एतदीदृशकं धर्मं प्रशंसन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: I regard both of them equally. I have none whom I like and none whom I dislike. The wise speak highly of such a course of conduct as consistent with duty or religion.

sa: ततः पित्रा चिरं स्तुत्वा चिरं चाघ्राय मूर्धनि। चिरं दो• परिष्वज्य चिरं जीवेत्युदाहृतः॥
en: The father praised his son for a long time, and smelt his head for a long time, and embraced him for a long time, and blessed him, uttering the words-Do you live long.

sa: एवमुक्ता निवृत्ता सा प्रविष्टा यज्ञपावकम्। किं नु दुश्चरितं यज्ञे दिदृक्षुः सा रसातलम्॥
en: Thus addressed by the Brahmana, the goddess Savitri desisted and entered the sacrificial fire from desire of seeing the nether world, and wishing to avoid the sight of other short-comings in that sacrifice.

sa: तस्याधर्मप्रवृत्तस्य दोषान पश्यन्ति साधवः॥ एकशीलाश्च मित्रत्वं भजन्ते पापकर्मिणः।
en: When he clearly begins to commit sin, the good notice his wickedness. Those, however, who are sinfully disposed contract friendship with him.

sa: दर्शनं श्रवणं घ्राणं स्पर्शनं रसनं तथा। उपपत्त्या गुणान् विद्धि पञ्च पञ्चसु पञ्चधा॥
en: Seeing, hearing, smelling, touching and tasting are the actions of the senses. The five senses, are connected with five objects in five ways. Know, by the inference of reason, their similitude of attributes.

sa: तथा विद्याधराश्चैव सिद्धाश्चैव तपोधनाः। महादेवं पशुपति पर्युपासन्त भारत॥
en: A large number of Vidyadharas, Siddhas and ascetics, too, O Bharata, went there for waiting upon Mahadeva, that Lord of all creatures.

sa: यदा मृतं च स्वजनं न ज्ञास्यसि कदाचन। सुखितं दुःखितं वापि ननु बोद्धव्यमात्मना॥
en: After your relatives have been carried away from this world by death, you cannot know what becomes of them there,—that is, whether they are happy or miserable. This fact ought to awaken you.

sa: वीतरागो जितक्रोधः सम्यग् भवति यः सदा। विषये वर्तमानोऽपि न स पापेन युज्यते॥
en: One who at all times becomes entirely freed from attachments and who completely subdues the passion of anger, is never sullied by sin even if he lives in the enjoyment of worldly objects.

sa: द्विविधानीह भूतानि पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपते। जङ्गमागमसंज्ञानि जङ्गमं तु विशिष्यते॥
en: There are two kinds of creatures on Earth, O king, viz., mobile and immobile. Of these, those that are mobile are superior.

sa: हित्वा च देहं प्रविशन्ति देवं दिवौकसौ द्यामिव पार्थ सांख्या:। अतोऽधिकं तेऽभिरता महार्हे सांख्ये द्विजाः पार्थिव शिष्टजुष्टे॥
en: Renouncing this body, those twice-born ones that follow the Sankhya system enter into the superior state of Brahma like the gods entering into the sky by devoting themselves wholly to that worshipful system which is theirs and which is adored by all wise men.

sa: तिर्यग्योनिसहस्रेषु कदाचिद् देवतास्वपि। उपपद्यति संयोगाद् गुणैः सह गुणक्षयात्॥
en: He attains to thousands of births among the intermediate orders and sometimes among the very gods on account his union with qualities.

sa: समानयानया चेह सह वासमहं कथम्। गच्छाम्यबुद्धभावत्वादेषेदानीं स्थिरो भवे॥
en: How shall I live conjointly with her? On account of my ignorance I repair to her companionship. I shall now be fixed.

sa: सा प्राप्य मिथिलां रम्यां प्रभूतजनसंकुलाम्। भैक्ष्यचर्यापदेशेन ददर्श मिथिलेश्वरम्॥
en: Arrived at the metropolis of Mithila having a large population, she adopted the guise of a mendicant and appeared before the king.

sa: न च कामसमायुक्ते युक्तेऽप्यस्ति त्रिदण्डके। न रक्ष्यते त्वया चेदं न मुक्तस्यास्ति गोपना॥
en: The triple stick is unfit for a Yogin who has desire. As regards yourself, you do not adhere to your stick. As regards those who are freed, they should protect themselves from fall.

sa: मा स्पाक्षीः साधु जानीष्व स्वशास्त्रमनुपालय। कृतेयं हि विजिज्ञासा मुक्तो नेति त्वया मम।
en: Do not continue to touch me. Know that I am righteous. Do you act according to your own scriptures. Your enquiry, viz., whether I am or I am not liberated, has been finished.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्येतैरसुखैर्वाक्यैरयुक्तैरसमञ्जसैः। प्रत्यादिष्टा नरेन्द्रेण सुलभा न व्यकम्पत॥
en: Bhishma said Though chastised by the king in these unpleasant, improper, and ill-applied words, the lady Sulabha was not at all abashed.

sa: हिरण्यरत्नसंचयाः शुभाशुभेन संचिताः। न तस्य देहसंक्षये भवन्ति कार्यसाधकाः॥
en: The gold and gems that one has acquired by good and bad means do not do any good to man after death.

sa: पश्यति च्छिन्नभूतं हि जीवलोकं स्वकर्मणा। तत् कुरुष्व तथा पुत्र कृत्स्नं यत् समुदाहृतम्॥
en: The wise man sees the world of life devastated by the deed performed by every living being. Do you, therefore, O son, act according to all the instructions I have delivered to you.

sa: तं ददर्शाश्रमपदे नारदः सुमहातपाः। अथैनमब्रवीत् काले मधुराक्षरया गिरा॥
en: At that time Narada of great ascetic merit came there for seeing Vyasa, and addressing him, said these words of sweet sound.

sa: यन्मया समनुष्ठेयं ब्रह्मर्षे तदुदाहर। विमुक्तस्येहं शिष्यैर्मे नातिहृष्टमिदं मनः॥
en: Tell me, O twice-born Rishi, what should now be done by me. Separated from my disciples, my mind has become very dispirited.

sa: तत्र मृत्युजरादुःखैः सततं समभिद्रुतः। संसारे पच्यते जन्तुस्तत्कथं नावबुद्ध्यसे॥
en: Always attacked by sorrow and decrepitude and death, a living creature is being cooked in this world. Do you not know it?

sa: न म्रियेरन् न जीर्येरन् सर्वे स्युः सर्वकामिनः। नाप्रियं प्रति पश्येयुरुत्थानस्य फले सति॥
en: If all attempts men make were successful then men would never die, would never be subject to decrepitude, would never meet with any disagreeable thing, and lastly would have all their wishes fructified.

sa: उल्कापाता दिशा दाहो भूमिकम्पस्तथैव च। प्रादुर्भूतः क्षणे तस्मिंस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: Meteors began to shoot. The points of the horizon seemed to be ablaze. The Earth trembled. All these phenomena seemed extremely wonderful.

sa: तं प्रक्रामन्तमाज्ञाय पिता स्नेहसमन्वितः॥ उत्तमा गतिमास्थाय पृष्ठतोऽनुससार ह।
en: Learning that Shuka had undertaken his great journey, his father Vyasa, filled with affection, followed him behind along the same aerial path.

sa: तां मुक्ततां तु विज्ञाय मुनिः पुत्रस्य वै तदा।॥ सक्ततामात्मनश्चैव प्रीतोऽभूद् व्रीडितश्च ह॥
en: Seeing these movements, the Rishi understood that his son had been liberated from all attachments, but that he himself was not freed therefrom. At this he became filled with both joy and shame.

sa: तस्मान्मे संशयं छिन्धि परं कौतूहलं हि मे। त्वं हि सर्वकथारामस्त्वां चैवोपाश्रिता वयम्॥
en: Do you remove my doubts! The curiosity I feel is very great. You are the repository of all histories and narratives. As regards ourselves, we entirely depend on you for knowledge and instruction.

sa: सिद्धा हि ते महाभागा नरा ह्येकान्तिनोऽभवन्। तमोरजोभ्यां निर्मुक्ताः प्रवेक्ष्यन्ति च मां मुने॥
en: Those highly blessed men who, having acquired ascetic success, become entirely devoted to me, become freed from the qualities of both Darkness and Ignorance and succeed, therefore, in entering me, O great ascetic.

sa: बध्या प्रसवमाप्नोति पुत्रपौत्रसमृद्धिमत्॥ क्षेमेण गच्छेदध्वानमिदं यः पठते पथि। यो यं कामं कामयते स तमाप्नोति च ध्रुवम्॥
en: A barren woman conceives and gets many sons and grandsons. He who recites this discourse on the way succeeds in passing happily and without any obstacles along his way. In fact, one acquires whatever objects he cherishes, if one reads or recites this narrative.

sa: सुदुःखान् नियमांस्तांस्तान् वहतः सुतपोधनान्। पश्यन् मुनीन् बहुविधान् प्रवेष्टुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Indeed, I saw various ascetics of the foremost order observing these and other painful vows. I wished then to enter that asylum.

sa: अर्धमानाश्च विबुधा ग्रहेण सुबलीयसा। शिवदत्तवरान् जघ्नुरसुरेन्द्रान् सुरा भृशम्॥
en: Afflicted by the mighty Mandara, the gods, fought hard against him and his companions, all of whom had got boons from Mahadeva.

sa: ततोऽहमब्रुवं बाल्याज्जननीमात्मनस्तथा। नेदं क्षीरोदनं मातर्यत् त्वं मे दत्तवत्यसि।
en: Moved by childishness I then addressed my mother, saying O mother, which you have given me is not any preparation of milk.

sa: ततो मामब्रवीन्माता दुःखशोकसमन्विता॥ पुत्रस्नेहात् परिष्वज्य मूर्ध्नि चाघ्राय माधव।
en: Filled with grief and sorrow at this, and embracing me from affection and smelling my head, O Madhava, she said to me.

sa: यं न पश्यन्ति चैवाद्धा देवा ह्यमितविक्रमम्। तमहं दृष्टवान् देवं कोऽन्यो धन्यतरो मया॥
en: Who clse is more praiseworthy than I, since I am seeing with these eyes of mine Him of immeasurable prowess whom the very gods are unable to see without first paying hearty worship?

sa: दशनामसहस्राणि देवेष्वाह पितामहः। शर्वस्य शास्त्रेषु तथा दशनामशतानि च॥
en: The Grandfather had at one time recited ten thousand names of Mahadeva. In the Scriptures, a thousand names of the god occur.

sa: पापं च ते न भविता अजेयश्च भविष्यसि। न ते प्रभविता मृत्युरजरश्च भविष्यसि॥
en: And he said to me you will be freed from sin and you will be invincible in battle. Death himself shall not succeed in overcoming you for you, will be freed from disease.

sa: ऋषिर्गृत्समदो नाम शक्रस्य दयितः सखा। प्राहाजमीढं भगवान् बृहस्पतिसमद्युतिः॥
en: The illustrious Rishi Gritsamada, the dear friend of Shakra, who resembled the celestial preceptor Brihaspati himself, addressing Yudhishthira of Ajamidha's race said.

sa: नाग्निं परित्यजेज्जातु न च वेदान् परित्यजेत्। न च ब्राह्मणमाक्रोशेत् समं तद् ब्रह्महत्यया॥
en: One should never quit his (homa) fire. One should also renounce the study of the Vedas. One should never attack a Brahmana by words or decds. All these offences are equal to Brahmanicide.

sa: उपाध्यायांश्च भृत्यांश्च भक्तांश्च भरतर्षभ। ये त्यजन्त्यविकारांस्त्रीस्ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who renounce preceptors and servants and loyal followers without any offence, o foremost of Bharata's race, have to sink in hell.

sa: नारदेनैव सहिताः समागम्येदमब्रुवन्। निवर्तस्व रणात् तात मानयस्व द्विजोत्तमम्॥
en: And accompanied by Narada, came up (to me) and thus spoke "Desist from the battle, O son. Honour that foremost of Brahmanas.

sa: अभिवाद्य तु राजानं युयुधानाच्युतार्जुनाः। हृष्टा विनिर्ययुस्ते वै युधिष्ठिरनिवेशनात्॥
en: Then having saluted the king, Yuyudhana, Arjuna and Krishna of unfading glory, with cheerful hearts, issued out of the chamber of Yudhishthira.

sa: सर्वलोकेश्वरस्येव परमेष्ठीप्रजापतेः। कथं प्रहर्तुमपि ते शेकुः संजय पाण्डवाः॥
en: O Sanjaya, how could the Pandavas succeed in striking Bhishma who was like Parameshti himself, that lord and creator of all creatures.

sa: दीप्तायां दिशि गोमायुर्दारुणं मुहुरुन्नदत्। अनाहता दुन्दुभयो विनेदु शनि:स्वनाः॥
en: The cardinal points were ablaze and jackals began to cry aloud every moment; and drums untouched began to give forth harsh sound.

sa: कर्णिनालीकनाराचैश्छादयामास तद् बलम्। अपातयद् ध्वजांश्चैव रथिनश्च शितैः शरैः॥
en: With barbed arrows, with Nalikas and Narachas, Bhishma covered that army of the Pandavas. He felled with whetted shafts elephants and car-warriors.

sa: तत्र देवगणा राजन् गन्धर्वासुरराक्षसाः। अप्सरोगणसंयुक्ताः शैले क्रीडन्ति सर्वदा॥
en: O king, there on that mountain the celestial, the Gandharvas, the Asuras and the Rakshasas with the Apasaras always come to sport.

sa: सैन्धवेन परामृष्टा परिभूय पितृन् मम। एतेषामपमानानामन्येषा च कुलाधम॥
en: Ruler of the Sindhus oppressed her disregarding my sires. O you the disgrace to your family, these and many other such insults.

sa: अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम्। अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर॥
en: Adhibhuta is all perishable things. Adhidaiva is the (primal) Male-Being. And O best of men, Adhiyajna is I myself in this body.

sa: महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवी प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः। भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम्॥
en: but high-souled and divine-natured devotees,, O Partha, knowing Me as the origin of all things, worship Me with minds directed to nothingelse.

sa: मूढाश्च ते तमेवाजौ विनदन्तः समाद्रवन्॥ सासिमुत्तमवेगेन विचरन्तं महारणे।
en: Only those that were foolish came rushing at him who was roving about that field of battle with sword in his hand.

sa: प्रहर्षपभिमानं च सुखप्राप्तिं च चिन्तयन्। एतद्बुद्धवा बुधाः शोकं न शोकः शोक उच्यते॥२०
en: The living man should think of the joy, the glory and the happiness of the dead. Acquainted with truth, the wise never harbour grief, for grief is nothing more or less than grief.

sa: विशालाक्षं सुकेशान्तं चारुवाक्यं सुगन्धि च। तव पुत्र कदा भूयो मुखं द्रक्ष्यामि निव्रणम्॥
en: When again O my son, shall I see that face of yours, graced with expansive eyes, covered with beautiful looks and from which sweet words and fragrant perfume used always to come out?

sa: यदा संहरते चायं कूर्मोऽङ्गानीव सर्वशः। इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता॥
en: His mind is steady who withdraws all his senses from all the (worldly) objects of senses, as a tortoise withdraws his limbs.

sa: तस्मिन् निपतिते वीरे सौभद्रो द्रोपदीसुतः॥ चेकितानो धृष्टकेतुर्युयुनसुश्चादयन् द्विपम्। त एनं शरधाराभिर्धाराभिरिव तोयदाः॥ सिषिचुभैरवान् नादान् विनदन्तो जिघांसवः।
en: On the fall of that hero (Ruchiparvan), the son of Subhadra, the sons of Draupadi, Chekitana, Dhristaketu and Yuyutsu, began to afflict that elephant. Desirous of slaying it; and uttering dreadful roars, they began to pour on it their arrows like showers of rain.

sa: भवन्तं समरे वीर विषहेम कथं वयम्। न हि ते सूक्ष्ममप्यस्ति रन्धं कुरुपितामह॥
en: How, O hero, shall we be competent enough to withstand you in battle? You do not disclose even the slightest weakness to your enemy, O grandsire of the Kurus, whereby to overthrow you.

sa: यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्मयादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते। सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथाऽऽत्मा नोपलिप्यते॥
en: As space for its subtility and as it is ubiquitous is never tainted, so Self stationed in every body, is never tainted.

sa: न त्वहं विनिवर्तिष्ये युद्धादस्मात् कथंचन। ततस्ते मुनयो राजनृचीकप्रमुखास्तदा॥
en: "But as for me, I will never hold back from this combat.” Then those ascetics, O king, with Richeeka at their head,

sa: सैनापत्यं च सम्प्राप्य कौरवाणां धुरन्धरः। किमचेष्टत गाङ्गेयो महाबुद्धिपराक्रमः॥
en: What did that oldest and foremost of the Kauravas, the of Ganga, of great intelligence and prowess, do after obtaining the generalship?

sa: परस्परेण धावन्तः पतिताः पुनरुत्थिताः॥ उत्थाय च प्रधावन्तो द्वन्द्वयुद्धमवाप्नुवन्।
en: Rushing upon one another, falling down and rising up again, and rushing again having risen up the combatants fought hand to hand.

sa: दन्तिभिश्चापरैस्तत्र सप्रसैर्गाढवैदनैः। करैः शब्दं विमुञ्चद्भिः शीकरं च मुमुर्मुहुः॥ विबभौ तद् रणस्थानं स्यन्दमानैरिवाचलैः। नानारागैः कम्बलैश्च परिस्तोमैश्च दन्तिनाम्॥
en: Then also with other elephants pierced with lances and pained to the extreme, and repeatedly uttering shrinks of agony with their trunks, the field of battle appeared beautiful as if covered with moving mountains. With blankets of various colors, and caparisons of elephants, sorts

sa: यदृच्छया चोपपन्नं स्वर्गद्वापरमपावृतम्। सुखिनः क्षत्रियाः पार्थ लभन्ते युद्धमीदृशम्॥
en: Happy are those Kshatriya who obtain such battle to fight, a battle coming of itself and being the open gate to heaven.

sa: रथाश्च रथिभित्ना निर्मनुष्याश्च वाजिनः। हतारोहाच मातङ्ग दिशो जग्मुर्भयातुराः॥
en: Cars without riders, steeds deprived of their riders and elephants having their drivers slain, ran in all directions being over-whelmed with panic.

sa: तस्य माद्रीसुतः केतुं धनुः सूतं हयानपि। नातिक्रुद्धः शरैश्छित्त्वा षष्ट्या विव्याध सौबलम्।। २३
en: Thereupon the son of Madri, wrought up with ire, cut down with his arrows, the standard, bow, charioteer and steeds of the son of Subala and then pierced the latter with sixty shafts.

sa: एवमुक्तसतु संक्रुद्धः शरवर्षेण पाण्डवम्। अभ्यवर्षत् सगोविन्दं धनुरादाय भास्वरम्॥
en: Thus spoken to, king Bhagadatta, inflamed with rage, took up a lustrous bow and showers of arrow on Pandu's son and Govinda.

sa: अथैनं शरवर्षेण समन्तात् पर्यवाकिरन्। पर्वतं वारिधाराभिः शरदीव बलाहकाः॥
en: Then they covered him with an arrow downpour, like clouds covering the mountains with a downpour of rain in the rainy season.

sa: धर्मराजश्च तान् सर्वानुपजग्राह पाण्डवः। महता मेघवर्णेन नागानीकेन पृष्ठतः॥
en: The Pandava, king Yudhishthira Dharmaraja followed all of them behind with a large force of elephants, each of the colour of clouds.

sa: वादिननादितानां च सोऽद्य न श्रूयते महान्। यदा प्रभृत्युप्लव्याच्छानितमिच्छञ्जनार्दनः॥
en: When Janardana of unfading glory out of the compassion he cherished for every creature, came here with a desire for concluding peace.

sa: समासाद्य तु कौन्तेयो राज्ञस्तान् भीष्मरक्षिणः। सुशाण्यथो राजन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: The son of Kunti then having approached those monarchs protected by Bhishma himself, addressing, O king, Susharma spoke these words to him.

sa: आर्जुनिश्चित्रसेनेन विद्धो बहुभिराशुगैः। अतिष्ठदाहवे शूरः किरन् बाणान् सहस्रशः॥
en: The son of Arjuna being pierced by Chitrasena with many swift-coursing arrows, pierced him in return on the breast with three shafts.

sa: अवस्थितं च प्रणिपत्य कृष्णं प्रीतोऽर्जुनः काञ्चनचित्रमाली। उवाच कोपं प्रतिसंहरेति गतिर्भवान् केशव पाण्डवानाम्॥
en: When Krishna stopped, Arjuna, adorned with a beautiful golden garland cheerful, bowed to him and he then thus spoke to him “Quell our wrath o Keshava, you are the refuge of the Pandavas.

sa: ततः शरसहस्रेण संनिवार्य महारथान्। हयान् काञ्चनसंनाहान् भीमस्य न्यहनच्छरैः॥
en: Having checked those mighty car-warriors with thousands of arrows, he killed with his arrows the horses of Bhima clad in golden armour.

sa: तथा दन्तिसहस्रेण मत्तानां वीर्यशालिनाम्। अश्वानां नियुतेनैव तथान्यैश्च महारथैः॥
en: As also by a thousand infuriate elephants endued with great mighty and a hundred thousand horses and numerous other mightycar-warriors. armour on

sa: शूरूणां गर्जतां राजन् संक्रुद्धानाममर्षिणाम्। श्रूयन्ते स्म गिरश्चित्राः परस्परवधैषिणाम्॥
en: Then there were heard the diverse words of challenge uttered by shouting heroes, inflamed with rage and desirous of slaying one another.

sa: सर्वेषा चैव भूतानामिदमासीन्मनोगतम्। त्रील्लोकानद्य संक्रुद्धो नृपोऽयं धक्ष्यतीति वै॥
en: Then this thought prevailed in the minds of all beings present, namely 'This king, waxing worth, will today consume the triune world.'

sa: अभिमन्युः सुसंक्रुद्धो भ्रातरं भरतर्षभ। शरैः पञ्चाशतै राजन् क्षिप्रहस्तोऽभ्यविध्यत॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, the light-handed Abhimanyu, also being very much enraged, soon wounded his cousin with five hundred arrows.

sa: यदुक्तश्च सभामध्ये पुरुषो ह्रस्वदर्शनः। क्रुद्धेन भीमसेनेन भ्राता दुःशासनस्तव॥ अधर्मज्ञो नित्यवैरी पापबुद्धिर्नृशंसवत्। सत्यां प्रतिज्ञामचिराद् द्रक्ष्यसे तां सुयोधन॥
en: What your brother Dushasana, that man of little foresight, who does not know what virtue is, who is ever hostile to me, who is sinful intellect and inhuman, has been told by the angry Bhimasena, you will soon see that resolve fulfilled, O Suyodhana.

sa: जानामि त्वा महाभाग पाण्डवानां हिते रतम्। तथा मुह्यामि च ब्रह्मन् कार्यवत्तां विचिन्तयन्॥
en: I know you, O illustrious one, to be attached to the interests of the Pandavas, therefore, O Brahmana. I am losing my sense in the thought what should be done by me next.

sa: हया हयान् समासाद्य प्रेषिता हयसादिभिः। समाहत्य रणेऽन्योन्यं निपेतुर्गतजीविताः॥
en: Urged on by their riders, encountering one another, horses dashed against one another, and fell down on the field deprived of life.

sa: फुल्लाशोकनिभः पार्थः शुशुभे रणमूर्धनि। विषाणे दन्तिनं गृह्य निर्विषाणमथाकरोत्॥
en: The son of Pritha appeared beautiful like a blossoming Ashoka tree. Catching the tuskers by their tusks, he rooted the tusks out,

sa: राजा शूरः कृती दक्षो वैरमुत्पाद्य पाण्डवैः। वीर स्वयं प्रयाह्यत्र यत्र पार्थो धनंजयः॥
en: You are a sovereign, a hero, possessed of fame and skilful in defeating (your opponents). O valorous subjugator of hostile fortresses, hie yourself, therefore to that part of the field where Dhananjaya is.

sa: ततोऽभ्ययात् सत्वरितो युद्धाकाक्षी महाबलः। तेन चक्रे महद् युद्धमभिमन्युररिंदमः॥
en: Then desirous of battle, Paurava possessed of great might assaulted Abliimanyu. Then that grinder of focs (Abhimanyu) battled fiercely with his antagonist.

sa: तामापतन्तीं सहसा कौरवाणां महाचमूम्। अभिदुद्राव वेगेन पाण्डवः श्वेतवाहनः॥
en: Thereupon that son of Pandu owning white steeds, rushed with velocity against the mighty army of the Kauravas that was speedily advancing.

sa: भगदत्तश्च समरे तेन नागेन भारत। विमृद्गन् पाण्डवबलं युधिष्ठिरमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Then in that combat, O Bharata, Bhagadatta also, crushing the ranks of the Pandavas with that elephant of his, assailed Yudhishthira himself.

sa: अहं त्वामनुयास्यामि परान् विद्रावयशरैः। अभिद्रव सुसंरब्धो भीष्मं भीमपराक्रमम्॥
en: 'I shall fight behind you crushing the enemy with my arrows; now inflamed with wrath, do you assail Bhishma of dreadful prowess.

sa: ततः प्रयात: सहसा भीष्मः शान्तनवोऽर्जुनम्। रणे भारतयामायन्तमाससाद महाबलः॥
en: Thereupon the son of Shantanu viz., Bhishma, while thus advancing suddenly encountered the mighty Arjuna of the Bharata race, coming towards himself.

sa: शिरसां पततां राजशब्दोऽभूद् वसुधातले। कालेन परिपक्वानां तालानां पततामिव॥
en: The sound then created by the falling of heads on the earth, resembled that produced by the falling of ripe palm fruit.

sa: तेषामादित्यवर्णानि विमलानि महान्ति च। श्वेतच्छत्राण्यशोभन्त वारणेषु रथेषु च॥
en: Their clean, costly and white umbrellas, as brilliant as the sun, shone on the back of their elephants and over their chariots.

sa: भीमसेनो गजानीकं योधयन् बह्वशोभत। यथा शक्रो वज्रपाणिर्दारयन् पर्वतोत्तमान्॥
en: Bhimasena then fighting with the elephant division looked highly beautiful, like the wielder of the thunder bolt himself running upon the mountains.

sa: अवश्यं तु मया कार्यं साह्यं सर्वदिवौकसाम्। ममेदं गात्रजं शक्र कवचं गृह्य भास्वरम्॥
en: Surely it is my duty to protect the denizens of heaven. O Shakra, take this radiant coat of mail off my body; and O lord of the gods, don it, reiterating these Mantras.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा ततो वाक्यं तिष्ठंश्चापवरासिमान्। न स्माशक्यत बीभत्सुः केनचित्प्रसमीक्षितुम्॥
en: Having spoken these words, Arjuna sat down armed with his bow and excellent sword. Then none was able to look at Vibhatsu.

sa: ततस्त्वस्त्राणि दिव्यानि जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान्। मयि प्रयोजयामास तान्यहं प्रत्यषेधयम्॥
en: Then did the illustrious son of Jamadagni shoot at me celestial weapons but I thwarted them off, O you of long arms.

sa: ते विंशतिपदं गत्वा सम्प्रहारं प्रचक्रिरे। पाण्डवा धार्तराष्ट्राश्च परस्परजिघांसवः॥
en: Proceeding only twenty steps, the Pandavas and the Dhritarashtra's began to strike one another, out of a desire for slaying one another.

sa: अभिवाद्य तथैवाहं रथमारुह्य भारत। युयुत्सुर्जामदग्न्यस्य प्रमुखे वीतभी: स्थितः॥
en: Having bowed down to him I got on it again and desirous of fight stood before Jamadgna, past the reach of fear.

sa: यथोक्तमेव कल्याणि सर्वमेतद् भविष्यति। भविष्यसि पुमान् पश्चात् कस्माच्चित्कालपर्ययात्॥
en: As I have spoken, O blessed one, so shall it all be. You will be a man after some time has elapsed."

sa: धनु:संस्थे महाराज द्वे वर्षे दक्षिणोत्तरे। इलावृतं मध्यमं तु पञ्च वर्षाणि चैव हि॥
en: O king, the last Varsha in the north and Bharata Varsha in the south are both of the form of a bow. Ilavrita is situated in the very middle of the five Varshas.

sa: पद्मपत्रनिभांश्चाश्वान् मल्लिकाक्षान् स्वलंकृतान्। शैखण्डिः क्षत्रदेवस्तु स्वयं प्रत्वरयन् ययौ॥
en: Kshatradeva, the son of Sikhandin, himself urging well-trapped steeds of the hue of lotusleaves and with pure white eyes, advanced towards Drona.

sa: तेजोवीर्यबलोपेता महाबलपराक्रमाः। घटोत्कचस्तु स्वं नागं चोदयामास तं तदा॥
en: And they were endued with prowess strength and might and great fleetness and courage. Then Ghatotkacha goaded his own elephants in battle,

sa: युधिष्ठिरो महेष्वासो मद्रराजानमाहवे। महत्या सेनया गुप्तं पीडयामास संगतम्॥
en: Then king Yudhishthira that great bowman, protected by a mighty division encountering the Madra king in battle began to afflict him sorely.

sa: द्रोणं पञ्चाशतेषूणां कर्णं च दशभिः शरैः। दुर्योधनं द्वादशभिद्रौणिमष्टाभिराशुगैः॥
en: He pierced Drona with fifty shafts and Karna with ten arrows and Duryodhana with twelve and Drona's son with eight swiftcoursing arrows.

sa: व्यास उवाच तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा नारदो वरदः प्रभुः। आख्यानमिदमाचष्ट पुत्रशोकापहं महत्॥
en: Vyasa said Having heard those words of his, the lord Narada, that bestower of boons, related this story that is capable of destroying the great sorrow caused by the death of one's son.

sa: तस्य पुत्रो हरि म नारायणसमो बले। श्रीमान् कृतास्त्रो मेधावी युधि शक्रोपमो बली॥
en: He had a son by name Hari, who was equal to Narayana himself in might; he was exceedingly handsome, accomplished in the use of weapons, intelligent, powerful and equal to Shakra in battle.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा व्यथितं भीममभिमन्युपुरोगमाः। नामृष्यन्त महेष्वासाः पाण्डवानां महारथाः॥
en: Beholding Bhima thus afflicted, the mighty car-warriors of the Pandava host headed by Abhimanyu, all of excellent parts could not brook it.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कथं द्रोणो महेष्वासः पाण्डवश्च धनंजयः। समीयतू रणे यत्तौ तावुभौ पुरुषर्षभौ॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How did those two foremost of men, those two fierce bowmen, namely Drona and Dhananjaya the son of Pandu encountering each other with each other to the best of their abilities?

sa: यथा मेरुर्महाराज शृङ्रत्यर्थमुच्छ्रितैः॥ सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासः पुत्रेण तव धन्विना।
en: The mount Meru with its crests towering high in the heavens. Pierced deeply by your son wielding the bow, that mighty bowman.

sa: येनासि बहुशो राज्ञा चोदितः सूतनन्दन। जातोऽसि धर्मलोपेन ततस्ते बुद्धिरीदृशी॥ नीचाश्रयान्मत्सरेण द्वेषिणी गुणिनामपि।
en: Your very birth attended with transgression of virtue. Therefore is your intellect thus (perverted). In consequence of your arrogance and also association with the mean, your heart harbors malice against even the meritorious.

sa: श्रीमभगवानुवाच इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम्। विवस्वान्मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत्॥
en: The great One said I told this imperishable (system of) Yoga to Vivasvat declared it to Manu; Manu declared it to lkshvaku.

sa: सारथिः प्रवरः कृष्णः शीघ्राश्चास्य हयोत्तमाः। अल्पं च विवरं कृत्वा तूर्णं याति धनंजयः॥
en: Krishna is the best of all drivers of chariots and his horses are the fleetest and the best of the species. Creating a small breath only, Dhananjaya can pass very quickly through it.

sa: राजानं तु तथाम्बष्ठमेकं युद्धाभिनन्दिनम्। चेदिराजः शरानस्यन् क्रुद्धो द्रोणादवारयत्॥
en: Excited with wrath the ruler of the Chedis, kept away, by discharging shafts, from Drona, king Ambastha who always delighted in battle.

sa: अथैनं पञ्चविंशत्या क्षुद्रकाणां समार्पयत्॥ हताश्वं रथमुत्सृज्य विकर्णस्तु महारथः।
en: Pierced the latter with twenty five short shafts then that mighty car-warrior Vikarna, leaving his chariot of which the steeds were slain,

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच भयं मे सुमहज्जातं विस्मयश्चैव संजय। श्रुत्वा पाण्डुकुमाराणां कर्म देवैः सुदुष्करम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Hearing of those feats achieved by the sons of Pandu-feats which are difficult of being achieved even by the celestial themselves, O Sanjaya, I have been filled with apprehension and amazement.

sa: चक्रव्यूहो महाराज आचार्येणाभिकल्पितः। तत्र शक्रोपमाः सर्वे राजानो विनिवेशिता॥
en: The circular array, O monarch, was then formed by the preceptor, in which were duly stationed kings, each equal to Indra himself.

sa: तमापतन्तं वेगेन शक्राशनिसमद्युतिम्। द्विधा चिच्छेद संक्रुद्धो द्रौणिः परमकोपनः॥
en: Then the irate son of Drona seeing the effulgent dare course swiftly like the thunderbolt of Indra, speedily cut it in twain.

sa: द्रोणभीष्मौ रणे यत्तौ धर्मराजस्य वाहिनीम्। नाशयेतां शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छदः॥
en: Drona and Bhishma fighting bravely began to slaughter the troops under Dharmaraja Yudhishthira with sharp arrows furnished with feathers of Kanka bird.

sa: वाक्यं हितं च पथ्यं च माः पथ्यमिवौषधम्। पुत्राणां मतमाज्ञाय जितान् मन्यसि पाण्डवान्॥
en: To our words, salutary and intended for your good though they were even as a sick man rejects wholesome medicines Accepting the views of your sons, you expected to see the Pandavas vanquished.

sa: अदर्शयद् वासुदेवो हययाने परं बलम्। मोघान् कुर्वशरांस्तस्य मण्डलान्याचरल्लघु॥
en: Vasudeva then displayed his great skill in the guiding the horses. He baffled those arrows by driving the car in quick circles.

sa: तथैव चेकितानोऽपि चित्रसेनमवारयत्। तद् युद्धमासीत् सुमहत् तयोस्तत्र समागमे॥
en: Similarly Chekitana also fought with him with equal ardor. Then fierce was the battle that commenced consequent upon their encountering each other.

sa: दीर्यमाणं बलं दृष्ट्वा सौभद्रे विनिपातिते। अजातशत्रुस्तान् वीरानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then upon the death of Abhimanyu, seeing his troops routed, Ajatasatru Yudhishthira addressed these words to the heroic warriors of his army-

sa: संजय उवाच यन्मां पृच्छसि राजेन्द्र सिन्धुराजस्य विक्रमम्। शृणु तत् सर्वमाख्यास्ये यथा पाण्डूनयोधयत्॥
en: Sanjaya said You ask me, O mighty monarch, to describe the prowess of the ruler of Sindhus. I shall describe all that in detail. Hear how he fought with the sons of Pandu.

sa: क्षत्रियाणां चतुःषष्टिमयुतानि. सहस्रशः। तदा मृत्योः समेतानि एकेन धनुषाऽजयत्॥
en: Single-handed and with a single bow, he vanquished and dispatched to the abode of Death, four and sixty times ten thousand Kshatriyas.

sa: संरब्धानां च वीराणां धीराणाममितौजसाम्। धनुातलशब्देन न प्राज्ञायत किंचन॥
en: Nothing could be heard in consequence of the flapping produced by bows of great toughness, belonging to cool-headed warriors excited with fury.

sa: सरथान् रथिनस्तूर्णं हयांश्चैव ससादिनः। गजारोहांश्च सगजान् दारयामास फाल्गुनिः॥
en: That son of Phalguna, soon shattered into pieces may cars with their rider and many elephant-warriors with the elephants they rode upon.

sa: संजय उवाच तदनीकमनाधृष्यं भारद्वाजेन रक्षितम्। पार्थाः समभ्यवर्तन्त भीमसेनपुरोगमा:॥
en: Sanjaya said The Parthas then led by Bhimasena marched against that invincible array of your soldiers protected by the son of Bharadvaja.

sa: आर्जुनि श्रुतकीर्ति तु द्रौपदेयं महारथम्। द्रोणायाभिमुखं यान्तं दौःशासनिरवारयत्॥
en: The son of Dushasana resisted the mighty car-warrior Shrutakirti, the son of Arjuna by Draupadi, as the latter was rushing at Drona.

sa: तमाद्रवन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य गर्जन्तमिव तोयदम्। अभ्यवर्तन्त संक्रुद्धाः पाण्डवानां महारथाः॥
en: Beholding him rush like a mass of roaring clouds, the mighty car-warriors of the Pandava host inflamed with wrath advanced with impetuosity.

sa: तमन्वगेवास्य पिता पुत्रगृद्धी न्यवर्तत। अनुदुर्योधनं चान्ये न्यवर्तन्त महारथाः॥
en: Preyed upon by anxiety on account of his son, his father (Duryodhana) turned back: and other mighty car-warriors also followed Duryodhana's example.

sa: विद्रवत्येव तत् सैन्यं पश्यतोःणभीष्मयोः। ततो रथसहस्रेषु विद्रवत्सु ततस्ततः।२३॥
en: Those troops fled away in the very sight of Drona and Bhishma. When those thousands of car-warriors fled away in all directions.

sa: नाकुलिं तु शतानीकं भूतकर्मा सभापतिः। अस्यन्तमिषुजालानि यान्तं द्रोणादवारयत्॥
en: Bhutakarma, the ruler of the Sabhas, kept away from Drona, Nakula's son, Shatanika, as the latter advanced discharging a net-work of arrows.

sa: एतदालोक्यते सैन्यं क्षोभ्यमाणं किरीटिना। महोर्मिनद्धं सुमहत् तिमिनेव महाजलम्॥
en: You is seen the army agitated by the diadem decked Arjuna, like the waters of the ocean agitated by a mighty whale.

sa: एकप्रहारनिहतान् भीमसेनेन दन्तिनः। अपश्याम रणे तस्मिन् गिरीन् वज्रहतानिव॥
en: In that battle, we also beheld elephants smashed by Bhimasena, each with a single stoke, like cliffs rent open by the thunder-bolt.

sa: तदद्भुतमपश्याम तावकानां परैः सह। एकायनगताः सर्वे यदयुध्यन्त भारत॥
en: Then, O Bharata, we beheld a delightful sight, when your warriors fought with the enemy, both inspired with a singleness of purpose.

sa: ततस्तत् पुनरावृत्तं युधिष्ठिरबलं महत्। दृष्ट्वा पार्थं महाबाहुं भीष्मायोद्यतमाहवे॥
en: Having scen the mighty armed son of Pritha thus rush to fight with Bhishma, the great army of Yudhishthira rallied for battle.

sa: यश्च मानुशमात्रोऽयमिति ब्रूयात् स मन्दधीः। हृषीकेशमवज्ञानात् तमाहुः पुरुषाधमम्॥
en: That one of perverted understanding who, out of contempt, call Hrishikesha a man is said to be the vilest of all creatures.

sa: अन्योन्यमभिमृद्नन्ति नगराणि युयुत्सवः। पद्मोत्पलानि वृक्षेषु जायन्ते कुमुदानि च॥
en: Being desirous of battle, they are breaking down the towns (they have made in sports). Lotuses and lilies are growing on trees.

sa: राज्याधु पञ्च वा ग्रामान् नाकार्षीत् स च दुर्मतिः। दृष्ट्वा हि क्षत्रियाशूराशयानान् धरणीतले॥
en: Either half of the kingdom or else five villages only. But the pervert Duryodhana turned deaf ears to our solicitations. Beholding these Kshatriyas, all brave warriors, prostrate on the surface of the earth.

sa: नरनारायणौ यौ तौ पुराणावृषिसत्तमौ। सहितौ मानुषे लोके सम्भूतावमितद्युती॥
en: Those ancient and illustrious sages namely Nara and Narayana, are incapable of being vanquished in battle by even the gods united together.

sa: पञ्चलाः केकयाश्चैव सिंहनादमथानदन्। वादित्राणि च सर्वाणि नानालिङ्गानि सर्वशः॥
en: Then filled with joy, the troops of the Pandavas struck up numerous musical instruments of various description and shape, from all sides.

sa: यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया। यत्र चैवात्मनाऽऽत्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति॥
en: That (state) in which mind, being retrained, ceases to work, in which one, seeing the self by self, is pleased in self.

sa: महारथौ च पाञ्चाल्यौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ। वीर्यवन्तौ महात्मानौ न गदाकार्मुकधारिणौ॥
en: And the two Maharathas, the ruler of Panchala, Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas, who were high-souled (warriors) of great prowess holding clubs and bows.

sa: पश्य दुःशासनं वीरमभिमन्युवशं गतम्॥ प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यं निघ्नन्तं शात्रवान् रणे।
en: Behold the heroic Dushasana worsted by Abhimanyu he who had been ere now slaying and scorching the foe like the sun himself.

sa: तौ समेतौ महायुद्धे क्रोधदीप्तौ परस्परम्। महाबलौ महाराज क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनौ॥
en: Those two highly powerful heroes, O monarch, meeting one another dreadful fight, both bring with rage and with eyes red in rage,

sa: ताः प्रेषितास्तत्त्वभावं विदित्वा प्रीत्या राज्ञे तच्छशंसुर्हि सर्वम्। शिखण्डिनं पुरुषं कौरवेन्द्र दाशार्णराजाय महानुभावम्॥
en: Those ladies, who had been despatched, having learnt the truth, praised all about Shikhandin who was a man of great strength, O best of Kuru's race, to the king of the Dasharna country.

sa: अथाब्रवीन्महाप्राज्ञो भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। हर्षेणोत्फुल्लनयनः कृपमाभाष्य सत्वरम्॥ घट्टयन्निव मर्माणि पुत्रस्य तव भारत। अभिमन्युं रणे दृष्ट्वा तदा रणविशारदम्॥
en: Thereupon the highly wise and valiant son of Bharadvaja, with his eyes blooming forth in delight, addressing Kripa quickly said, beholding then Abhimanyu proficient in battle he said these words of Kripa, O Bharata, thereby seeming to pierce the very vitals of your sons.

sa: अभिमन्यु बृहन्तं च द्रौपदेयांश्च सर्वशः। धृष्टद्युम्नमुखानेतान् प्राहिणोत् पाण्डुनन्दनः॥
en: And the son of Pandu ordered Abhimanyu and Brihanta and all Draupadeyas, (the five sons of Draupadi), headed by Dhrishtadyumna, to advance.

sa: शय्याश्च विविधास्तात तेषां रात्रौ युधिष्ठिरः। एवंवेदी वेदितव्यः पाण्डवेयोऽयमित्युत॥
en: Yudhishthira fixed various appellation so that by uttering them they might be known to others that they belong to the Pandava force.

sa: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ केकया बाह्निकैः सह। प्रययुः सर्व एवैते भारद्वाजपुरोगमा:॥
en: (First of all) Vinda and Anuvinda, both of Avanti, and the Kaikeyas with the Balhika's went out with Bharadvaja at their head.

sa: पातयिष्यामि दुर्धर्षं भीष्मं कुरुपितामहम्। स चाश्वान् रजतप्रख्यांश्चोदयामास माधवः॥
en: I will lay low Bhishma the grandsire of the Kurus." Thereupon that descendant of Madhu's race, drove those steeds of Argentine hue,

sa: संदर्शयिष्यन्नस्त्राणि विचित्राणि लघूनि च। आणुनिः समरे शूरो मृदुपूर्वमयुध्यत॥
en: Holding diverse kinds of weapons, all beautiful and swift-going, to the gaze of the people, Arjuna's heroic son battled with them mildly.

sa: हिमवान् हेमकूटश्च निषधश्च नगोत्तमः। नीलश्च वैदूर्यमयः श्वेतश्च शशिसंनिभः॥
en: They are named Himavat, Hemakut that foremost of mountains Nishadha, Nila that abounds in Vaidurya gems, Shveta, as white as the moon,

sa: स तेन नागप्रवरेण पार्थिवो भृशं जगाहे द्विषतामनीकिनीम्। पुरा सुगुप्तां विवुधैरिवाहवे विरोचनो देववरूथिनीमिव॥
en: That monarch (Bhagadatta) with that foremost elephant of his, thoroughly agitated the host of the enemy, like Virochana agitating in battle the celestial host well-protected by the immortals in the days of yore.

sa: धूमकेतुर्महाघोरः पुष्यं चाक्रम्य तिष्ठति। सेनयोरशिवं घोरं करिष्यति महाग्रहः॥
en: A fearful comet is rising, and is distressing the constellation Pushya. This great planet will cause terrible harm to both the armies.

sa: द्रौपदेयास्ततः पञ्च पञ्चभिः समताडयत्। भीमसेनस्य च क्रोधान्निजघान तुरङ्गमान्॥
en: Then again he pierced the five sons of Draupadi with five shafts, and inflamed with rage he slew the chargers of Bhimasena.

sa: सम्बन्धकेन राजेन्द्र तौ तु वीर्यबलान्वयात्। आर्यवृत्तौ महेष्वासौ स्नेहवीर्यसितावुभौ॥
en: Owing to their relationship with the Pandavas, O chief among king, those two great bowmen will get an increase of their energy.

sa: वासुदेवस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा जगाम शिरसा क्षितिम्। पार्थेन सह धर्मात्मा गृणन् ब्रह्म सनातनम्॥
en: Beholding the god, the pious-souled son of Vasudeva, together with the son of Pritha, saluted him by touching the earth with his head; and he uttered then the eternal verses from the Vedas.

sa: प्रकृति स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः। भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात्॥
en: Controlling My Nature Myself, I bring forth again, and again this whole assemblage of entities, which has no will of its own.

sa: यो वेद मानुषं व्यूहं दैवं गान्धर्वमासुरम्। कथं भीष्मं स कौन्तेयः प्रत्यव्यूहत संजय॥
en: O Sanjaya, how did the son of Kunti form his counter array of troops against Bhishma who knew all kinds of Vyuhas, those of the celestial, the Gandharvas, the Asuras and the men.

sa: वृषसेनो रथस्तेऽग्यः कर्णपुत्रो महारथः । प्रधक्ष्यति रिपूणां ते बलं तु बलिनां वरः॥
en: That great car warrior, Vrishasena, the son of Karna is one of the foremost of the carwarriors on your side; and that foremost among mighty persons will consume the army of your enemies.

sa: सहस्रनेत्रपादाय नमोऽसंख्येयकर्मणे। नमो हिरण्यवर्णाय हिरण्यकवचाय च। भक्तानुकम्पिने नित्यं सिध्यतां नो वरः प्रभौ॥
en: Salutations unto him of the complexion of gold, who is clad in a armour of gold; and unto him who is ever gracious upon his devotees. O lord let our desires be fulfilled.

sa: संवर्त उवाच वज्रादुग्राद् व्येतु भयं तवाद्य वातो भूत्वा हन्मि नरेन्द्र वज्रम्। भयं त्यक्त्वा वरमन्यं वृणीष्व कं ते कामं मनसा साधयामि॥
en: Samvarta said O king, the fear in your mind from this terrible thunderbolt will leave you immediately. I shall remove the thunder by the help of the winds, and setting aside all fear from your mind, do you accept a boon from me according to your heart's desire, and I shall do it for you.

sa: अलंकृतानां देवेश दिव्यैः कनकभूषणैः। रथानां काञ्चनाङ्गानां सहस्राण्यददं दशा॥
en: I gave away ten thousand cars, Grandfather, whose parts were made of gold, and which were adorned with various ornaments of gold.

sa: गौरिव प्रसवत्यर्थान् रसमुत्तमशालिनी। सततं स्यन्दते ह्येषा शाश्वतं ब्रह्मवादिनी॥
en: Like a cow having milk, she yields various kinds of ineaning. This one always gives the Eternal (viz., Emancipation), speaking of Brahma.

sa: यस्तु रौद्रसमाचारः सर्वसत्त्वभयंकरः। हस्ताभ्यां यदि वा पद्भ्यां रज्ज्वा दण्डेन वा पुनः।। लोष्टैः स्तम्भैरायुधैर्वा जन्तून् बाधति शोभने। हिंसार्थं निकृतिप्रज्ञः प्रोद्वेजयति चैव ह॥ उपक्रामति जन्तूंश्च उद्वेगजननः सदा। एवंशीलसमाचारो निरयं प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: That man who is fierce in conduct, who creates terror in all creatures, who injures other beings with hands or feet or cords or sticks, or brickbats or clods of hard clay, or other means of wounding and paining, O beautiful lady, who practises various kinds of deceit for killing living creatures or vexing them, who chases animals and causes them to tremble in fear, indeed, that man, who acts thus, is certain to sink in Hell.

sa: ब्रूहि विप्र यथाकामं प्रतिवक्तास्मि ते वचः। छेत्तास्मि सशयं तेऽद्य न मेऽत्रास्ति विचारणा॥
en: Saudasa said Say, O learned Brahmana, what is in your mind. I shall certainly reply to your words. I shall remove whatever doubt may being your mind. I have no hesitation in this.

sa: न हि पुण्यं तथा पापं किंचिद् विनश्यति। पर्वकाले च यत् किंचिदादित्यं चाधितिष्ठति॥
en: Nothing is lost of either virtue or sin that is committed by creatures. On days of the full moon and the new moon, those acts are taken to the Sun where they rest.

sa: तस्माद् विशिष्टां गच्छन्ति प्राणदा इति नः श्रुतम्। अन्नं वापि प्रभवति पानीयात् कुरुसत्तम।
en: Hence, we have heard that they who give life attain to very superior regions of happiness in after life. Food, O best of the Kurus, may or may not be superior to drink.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा नैष्ठिकी बुद्धिं बुद्ध्येथाः कर्मनिश्चयम्। तारारूपाणि सर्वाणि यत्रैतच्चन्द्रमण्डलम्॥
en: Those regions where creatures live when they ascend from this world, I shall now declare truly. Do you listen to me attentively.

sa: रसानां प्रतिसंहारात् सौभाग्यमिह विन्दति। आमिषप्रतिसंहारात् प्रजा ह्यायुष्मती भवेत्॥
en: By avoiding the several agreeable tastes one succeeds in winning great prosperity. By abstaining from meat and fish, one gets longlived children.

sa: येषां नाग्रभुजो विप्रा देवतातिथिबालकाः। राक्षसानेव तान् विद्धि निर्विशङ्कानमगलान्॥
en: Those unscrupulous and wicked men who eat without First serving Brahmanas and celestials and guests and children, should be known as Rakshasas,

sa: नहुषो हि महाराज राजर्षिः सुमहातपाः देवराज्यमनुप्राप्तः सुकृतेनेह कर्मणा॥
en: The royal sage Nahusha, O monarch, having penances for wealth, acquired the sovereignty of the celestial region by his own good deeds.

sa: नहुष उवाच उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ विप्रर्षे गवा क्रीतोऽसि भार्गव। एतन्मूल्यमहं मन्ये तव धर्मभृतां वर॥
en: Nahusha said Rise, rise, O twiceborn Rishi, you have been purchased, O son of Bhrigu, with a cow as your price! O foremost of righteous persons, even this, I think, is your price!
