sa: एष देवि सतां धर्मो मन्तव्यो भूतिकारकः। नृणां हितार्थाय मया तव वै समुदाहृतः॥
en: This, O goddess, is the line of conduct that the pious are to follow and that is fraught with great good. I have told you of it for the behoof of human beings.

sa: गच्छ विप्र त्वमद्यैव आलयं स्व महाद्युते। ब्रूहि सर्वं यथा स्वैरं करवाणि किमच्युत॥
en: Do you, O learned Brahmana of great splendour, return forthwith to your house. Tell me what also is in your mind and what I can do for you, O you of unfading glory.

sa: यद् वै ददाति विप्रेभ्यो ब्राह्मणः प्रतिगृह्य वै। उभयोः स्यात् तदक्षय्यं दातुरादातुरेव च॥
en: The Brahmana, who having accepted a gift of gems, makes a gift of them to Brahmanas, wins endless merit himself and confers endless merit upon him from whom he had originally received them.

sa: तथैव चानुयात्रादि चोदयामास पाण्डवः। सज्जयध्वं प्रयास्यामो नगरं गजसाह्वयम्॥
en: The son of Pandu then ordered all his attendants, saying, 'Prepare your selves and be ready. We shall go today to Hastinapur.

sa: यं कालं नागतो राजन् गुरुस्तस्य महात्मनः। क्रतुं समाप्य स्वगृहं तं कालं सोऽभ्यरक्षत॥
en: It was in this way, o king, that Vipula continued to protect the lady till the time of his great preceptor's return after accomplishing the sacrifice which he had gone out to perform.

sa: यो यदिच्छति यावच्च तावत् स लभते नरः। शयनं भोजनं यानं मणिरत्नमथो धनम्॥
en: Every man received what thing he wished and as much of it as he wished, Beds and foods, and cars and conveyances, and jewels and gems, and other wealth were given away profusely.

sa: निर्देष्टुं प्राणिभिः कैश्चित् प्राकृतैर्मांसलोचनैः। नोष्णं न शिशिरं तत्र न वायुर्न च भास्करः॥
en: And no creature with his natural eyes made of flesh, can ever see its shape or figure, and neither heat nor cold prevails there, nor does the sun shine or the winds blow.

sa: आश्रमं ते ततो जग्मुधृतराष्ट्रस्य पाण्डवाः। शून्यं मृगगणाकीर्णं कदलीवनशोभितम्॥
en: The Pandavas then reached the sacred hermitage of Dhritarashtra which abounded with herds of deer and which was adorned with plantain plants.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यस्त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः। एतेषु विहितो धर्मो ब्राह्मणस्य युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bhishma said The Brahman, the Kshatriya, and the Vaishya are considered the three twiceborn castes, To marry in these three castes has been ordained to be the duty of the Brahmana, O Yudhishthira.

sa: केकाभिर्नीलकण्ठानां दात्यूहानां च कूजितैः। कोकिलानां कुहुरवैः सुखैः श्रुतिमनोहरैः॥
en: The entire forest seemed to resound with the notes of peacocks and Datyuhas and Kokilas and the sweet songs of other warblers.

sa: सूकरो जातमात्रस्तु रोगेण म्रियते नृप। श्वा ततो जायते मूढः कर्मणा तेन पार्थिव॥
en: As soon as he takes birth in that order he dies of disease, O king. The wretch has next to take birth as a dog, O king, on account of that sinful deed.

sa: हत्वा भक्षयतो वापि परेणोपहतस्य वा। हन्याद् वा यः परस्यार्थं क्रीत्वा वा भक्षयेन्नरः॥
en: You have said SO So while discoursing formerly upon the ordinances about Shraddhas. How can meat, however, be procured without killing a living creature? Your declarations, therefore, appear to me to be contradictory.

sa: कोटीशतसहस्रं च दशकोटिशतानि च। रुद्रं नित्यं प्रणमते देवदानवसम्मतम्॥
en: For those numberless years he experiences the joy of bending his head in respect to Rudra worshipped by the celestials and Danavas.

sa: अप्येवात्मवधं लोके राजंस्त्वं बहु मन्यसे। न हि प्रतिज्ञा या दत्ता तां प्रहातुमरिंदम॥
en: 0 king, you make too much of the destruction of your kinsmen and friends in battle. You should remember, however, O chastiser of enemies, that it is not fair to break a promise.

sa: एष देव मया प्रोक्तः स्त्रीधर्मो वचनात् तव। या त्वेवंभाविनी नारी सा पतिव्रतभागिनी॥
en: I have thus, O god, explained at your command, what the duties of women are. Indeed, that woman who acts thus, becomes entitled to a share of the merits acquired by her husband.

sa: युधिष्ठिरो धर्मसुतो व्यासं वचनमब्रवीत्। भवत्प्रसादाद् भगवन् यदिदं रत्नमाहृतम्॥ उपयोक्तुं तदिच्छामि वाजिमेधे महाक्रतौ।
en: After having conversed on various topics, Dharma's son Yudhishthira addressed Vyasa and said, This treasure, O holy one, which has been brought through your favour, I desire to devote to that great Horse-Sacrifice.

sa: दानवद्भिः कृतः पन्था येन यान्ति मनीषिणः। ते हि प्राणस्य दातारस्तेभ्यो धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: The path made by charitable persons, is always trod by the wise. They who make gifts of food, are considered as givers of life. The merit they acquire by such gifts, is eternal.

sa: इन्दीवरश्यामतनुः स्थिता तु यैषा परासन्नमहीतले च। भार्या मता माद्रवतीसुतस्य ज्येष्ठस्य सेयं कमलायताक्षी॥
en: Possessed of complexion dark as the blue lotus, she who sits there on the earth, and whose eyes are as expansive as lotus-petals, she is the wife of the eldest son of Madravati,

sa: उमोवाच भगवन् केन ते वक्त्रं चन्द्रवत् प्रियदर्शनम्। पूर्वं तथैव श्रीकान्तमुत्तरं पश्चिमं तथा॥
en: Uma said O Holy One, why are those faces of yours which are on the east, the north and the west, so beautiful and so agreeable to look at like the very moon.

sa: नारीणां चरितज्ञश्च देवशर्मा महामुनिः॥ यथाशक्ति यथोत्साहं भार्यां तामभ्यरक्षत।
en: The great ascetic Devasharman fully knew the disposition of women. He therefore, to the best of his power and energy, protected her.

sa: एवं गते तु किं शक्यं मया कर्तुमरिंदम। मम दोषोऽयमत्यर्थं ख्यापितो यन्न सूर्यजः॥
en: When such has been the case, O chastise of enemies, what can I now do? I am very much to blame for 1101 having said the truth about the birth of Surya's child.

sa: दुर्मरं बत वार्ष्णेय कालेऽप्राप्ते नृभिः सह॥ यत्र मे हृदयं दुःखाच्छतधा न विदीर्यते।
en: Since my heart does not from grief break into a hundred pieces, it seems, O you of the Vrishni race, that it does not die with men when its hour does not come.

sa: रथं हेमपरिष्कारं दिव्याश्वयुजमुत्तमम्। धर्मराजश्च भीमश्च फाल्गुनश्च यमौ तथा॥
en: Then king Yudhishthira the just, and Bhima, and Phalguna, and the twins, each separately honored him and made costly presents to him.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ब्राह्मण्यं तात दुष्प्राप्यं वर्णैः क्षत्रादिभिस्त्रिभिः। परं हि सर्वभूतानां स्थानमेतद् युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bhishma said The dignity of a Brahmana, O Yudhishthira, cannot be acquired by a person belonging to any of the three other castes. That dignity is the highest with respect to all creatures.

sa: तमो रजस्तथा सत्त्वं गुणानेतान् प्रचक्षते। अन्योन्यमिथुनाः सर्वे तथान्योन्यानुजीविनः॥
en: Ignorance, Darkness, and Goodness, these are called the (three) qualities. These are connected with one another. They exist depending on one another.

sa: नहुषोऽपि त्वया राजंस्तस्माच्छापात् समुद्धृतः। जगाम ब्रह्मभवनं पश्यतस्ते जनाधिप॥
en: You have, o king rescued Nahusha from Bhrigu's curse. Rescued by you, he ascended to the region of Brahman before your eyes.

sa: भोजनं भोजनार्थिभ्यो दापयामास शत्रुहा। भीमसनो महातेजाः सततं राजशासनात्॥
en: Bhimasena of great energy, at the command of the king, caused food to be ceaselessly distributed among those who desired to eat.

sa: यथा लवणमम्भोभिराप्लुतं प्रविलीयते। प्रायश्चित्तहतं पापं तथा सद्यः प्रणश्यति॥
en: If a quantity of water be poured upon salt, the latter is immediately dissolved. So when expiation is performed, sin is dissipated.

sa: ये सर्वातिथयो नित्यं गोषु च ब्राह्मणेषु च। नित्यं सत्ये चाभिरता दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते॥
en: They who are hospitable to all persons who come to them as guests, and who are always devoted to Brahmanas and kine as also to truth succeed in crossing all calamities and impediments.

sa: अर्चयन्नतिथीन् काले दद्याच्चापि प्रतिश्रयम्। फलपत्रावरैर्मूलैः श्यामाकेन च वर्तयन्॥
en: Honouring guests when they come, he should give them shelter, and himself live upon fruits and leaves and common roots, and Shyamaka.

sa: श्रीरुवाच दिष्ट्या प्रसादो युष्माभिः कृतो मेऽनुग्रहात्मकः। एवं भवतु भद्रं वः पूजितास्मि सुखप्रदाः॥
en: Shree said By good luck, you have shown me much favour. Let it be even as you say! Blessed by you all, I have really been honoured by you, you givers of happiness.

sa: पुरागस्त्यो महातेजा दीक्षा द्वादशवार्षिकीम्। प्रविवेश महाराज सर्वभूतहिते रतः॥
en: Formerly, O king, Agastya of great energy, devoted to the well-being of all creatures, entered into a Diksha extending for twelve years.

sa: गण्डोवाच अनृतं भाषतु सदा बन्धुभिश्च विरुध्यतु। ददातु कन्यां शुल्केन बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः॥
en: Ganda said Let her who has stolen the lotusstalks be always a speaker of untruth. Let her always fall out with her kinsmen! Let her give away her daughter in marriage for money.

sa: यज्ञैरेव महात्मानो बभूवुरधिकाः सुराः। ततो देवाः क्रियावन्तो दानवनभ्यधर्षयन्॥
en: It is through sacrifices that the great celestials had grown so wondrously powerful; and having celebrated rites did they defeat the Danavas.

sa: त्रिसहस्रपरो दायः स्त्रियै देयो धनस्य वै। भळ तच्च धनं दत्तं यथार्हे भोक्तुमर्हति॥
en: The highest sum that the husband should give the wife is three thousand coins. This wealth that the husband gives to the wife, the latter may spend or dispose of as she likes.

sa: स्वयं विनाश्य पृथिवीं यज्ञार्थं द्विजसत्तम। करमाहारयिष्यामि कथं शोकपरायणः॥
en: How, O foremost of twice-born ones, having myself destroyed the Earth, can I, overwhelmed with sorrow, levy dues for celebrating a sacrifice?

sa: व्यास उवाच ततः प्रायाद् धूमकेतुर्महात्मा वनस्पतीन् वीरुधश्चाप्यमृद्नन्। कामाद्धिमान्ते परिवर्तमानः काष्ठातिगो मातरिश्वेव नर्दन्॥
en: Vyasa said Then the great Fire-God went on his errand, laying waste all the forests and trees, like the powerful wind, roaring and revolving at random at the end of the winter season.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तवन्तं ब्रह्मा तु राजानं स भगीरथम्। पूजयामास पूजाहँ विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥
en: Bhishma said King Bhagiratha, who had said so and who was worthy of every honour, was, on the conclusion of his speech, honoured by Brahman according to the rites ordained for that purpose.

sa: ततः स राजा मेधावी विवक्षू प्रेक्ष्य तावुभौ। प्रोवाच वदतां श्रेष्ठो वचनं राजसत्तमः॥
en: Then the king, king, gifted gifted with great intelligence, seeing those two friends, became desirous of addressing them. Soon that best of kings, that foremost of speakers, addressed them in the following words.

sa: तत्र रुद्राश्च साध्याश्च विश्वेऽथ वसवस्तथा। यमश्च वरुणश्चैव कुबेरश्च सहानुगः॥ भूतानि च पिशाचाश्च नासत्यावपि चाश्विनौ। गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव यक्षा देवर्षयस्तथा॥ आदित्या मरुतश्चैव यातुधानाश्च सर्वशः। उपासन्ते महात्मानं बहुरूपमुमापतिम्॥
en: And there the Rudras, the Saddhyas, the Vishvedevas, the Vasus, Yama, Varuna, and Kubera with all his followers, and the spirits and globins, and the two Ashvins, the Gandharvas, the Apsaras, the Yakshas, as also the celestial sages, the Sun Gods, as well as the gods presiding over the winds, and evil spirits of all sorts, adore the great lord of Uma, gifted with diverse characteristics.

sa: सा भत्रे सर्वमाचष्ट रुचिः सुरुचिरानना। भगिन्या भाषितं सर्वमृषिस्तच्चाभ्यनन्दत॥
en: Ruchi of beautiful face, speedily informed her husband of that request of her sister. The Rishi accepted the prayer of his sisterinlaw.

sa: पौषमासस्य शुक्ले वै यदा युज्येत रोहिणी। तेन नक्षत्रयोगेन आकाशशयनो भवेत्॥ एकवस्त्रः शुचिः स्नातः श्रद्दधानः समाहितः। सोमस्य रश्मयः पीत्वा महायज्ञफलं लभेत्॥
en: In the lighted fortnight of the month of Pausha, when the constellation Rohini is in conjunction, if one purifying himself by a bath lies, under the canopy of heaven clad in a single piece of cloth, with faith and rapt attention, and drinks the rays of the Moon, he wins the merits of great sacrifices,

sa: जाह्नवीपुलिनोत्थाभिः सिकताभिः समुक्षितम्। आत्मानं मन्यते लोको दिविष्ठमिव शोभितम्॥
en: One besmeared with the sand taken from the shores of Ganga considers oneself as an inhabitant of heaven, adorned with celestial unguents.

sa: शैवालं शीर्णपर्णं वा तद्वती यो निषेवते। शीतयोगवहो नित्यं स गच्छेत् परमां गतिम्॥
en: That man who lives upon the moss he gathers and the fallen leaves of trees that he picks up, and puts up with all the severities of cold, acquires a very high place.

sa: पारक्ये भूमिदेशे तु पितॄणां निर्वपेत् तु यः॥ तद्भूमिं वापि पितृभिः श्राद्धकर्म विहन्यते।
en: When a man performs a Shraddha in honour of the departed manes on earth belonging to another person, the departed manes render both the gift of that earth and the Shraddha itself fruitless.

sa: मार्गार्हस्य च ये मार्गं न यच्छन्त्यल्पबुद्धयः। पाद्यार्हस्य च ये पाद्यं न ददत्यल्पबुद्धयः॥
en: Gifted with little understanding, they do not give way to them who deserve such an honour. Nor do they give water for washing the feet to persons to whom it should be given.

sa: व्रीहौ पुष्पे फले चैव जले पिष्टमये तथा। यावके दधिदुग्धे च सावित्रीं शतशोऽन्विताम्॥
en: If one accepts paddy, flowers fruits, water half ripe barley, milk or curdled milk or anything made of meal or flour the expiation is done by reciting the Gayatri prayer a hundred times.

sa: दिवि ज्योतिर्यथाऽऽदित्यः पितॄणां चैव चन्द्रमाः। देवेशश्च तथा नृणां गङ्गा च सरितां तथा॥
en: As the solar ray is to the gods in the celestial region, as the moon is to the departed manes, as the king is to human beings, so is Ganga to all rivers.

sa: हुताशनस्तु बुबुधे मण्डूकस्य च पैशुनम्। शशाप स तमासाद्य न रसान् वेत्स्यसीति वै॥
en: The eater of sacrificial libations came to know of the treachery of the frog. Coming to that animal, he cursed the whole race, saying, You will be deprived of the organ of taste.

sa: स गत्वा हवनीयेऽग्नौ तीव्र नियममास्थितः। जुहाव संस्कृतैर्मन्त्रैरेकैकामाहुतिं नृपः॥
en: Practising the austerest of penances, he poured on his sacred fire libations of clarified butter, accompanying each with Mantras uttered by him.

sa: स्रोतश्च यावद्गङ्गायाश्छन्नमासीज्जगत्पते॥ दक्षिणाभिः प्रवृत्ताभिर्मम नागां च तत्कृते। वाजिनां च सहस्रे द्वे सुवर्णशतभूषित॥ वरं ग्रामशतं चाहमेकैकस्य त्रिधाददम्।
en: In those sacrifices, O Lord of the universe, I made presents as profuse as the stream of Ganga herself. Each Brahmana I gave two thousand elephants decked with gold, as many horses adorned with golden ornaments, and a hundred villages of the best kind.

sa: पाण्डवास्तुष्टुवुः सर्वे प्रणेमुश्च मुहुर्मुहुः। प्रसन्नमनसः सर्वे गाङ्गेयं कुरुसत्तमम्॥
en: They then cheerfully waited upon the son of Ganga even as Brahmanas versed in Mantras wait with respect upon the rising Sun.

sa: मम त्वनुग्रहार्थाय प्रविशस्व पुरं स्वकम्। भार्याभ्यां सह धर्मज्ञ मा भूत् तेऽत्र विचारणा॥
en: For, however, showing your grace towards me, do you enter your own city with your two wives. Do not cherish any scruple about this, O you who are fully acquainted with every duty!

sa: दिव्यं चक्षुरवाप्नोति प्रेत्य दीपस्य दायकः। पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतीकाशा दीपदाश्च भवन्त्युत॥
en: The giver of lights is sure to win celestial vision after death. Givers of light become as resplendent as the full moon.

sa: ततस्तदौषधीनां च वीस्थां पुष्पपत्रजम्। सर्वं वर्षाभिनिवृत्तमनं सम्भवति प्रभो॥
en: O powerful one, the moisture, thus poured, spreading itself into the leaves and fruits of vegetables and herbs, is changed into food.

sa: बृहस्पतिप्रभृतिभिर्मन्ये सद्भिः कृतानि वै। सम्पूज्यमानाः पुरुषैर्विकुर्वन्ति मनो नृप॥
en: Whether treated by men, with respect or with hatred, women are seen to turn the heads and agitate the hearts of men.

sa: शिष्टान्यङ्गानि यान्यासं स्तस्याश्वस्य नराधिप।॥ तान्यग्नौ जुहबु/राः समस्ताः षोडशार्विजः।
en: The remaining limbs, O king, of that horse, were poured into the fire by the sixteen sacrificial priests possessed of great wisdom.

sa: ततस्तौ सत्यसंकल्पौ मेरौ काञ्चनपर्वते। रमणीये शिलापृष्ठे सहितौ संन्यषीदताम्॥
en: Both of them were in the truth. Having met each other, they sat down on charming breast of the golden mount Meru.

sa: संहारे सर्वतो जाते पृथिव्यां शोकसम्भवे। बह्वीनामुत्तमस्त्रीणां सीमन्तोद्धरणे तथा॥
en: Everything on carth was under-going ai woeful destruction, during that battle when numberless ladies of birth and beauty were being made widows.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच आसीत् पूर्वं महाराज मुनिर्धीमान् महातपाः। दधीच इति विख्यातो ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Formerly. O king, there was an intelligent sage of great ascetic viriuc. He was celebrated by the name of Dadhicha. Having governed his senses, he led the life of a Brahmacharin.

sa: तैश्चैव सहित: क्षिप्रमस्तं गच्छति भास्करे॥ प्रविष्टो हास्तिनपुरं बाष्पकण्ठोऽश्रुलोचनः।
en: The sun was setting. With those ladies, Yuyutsu entered the city of Hastinapur, with tearful eyes and with voice suppressed in grief.

sa: अपि चैषां भयं तीव्र पार्थेभ्योऽभूत् सुदारुणम्। प्रेक्षमाणास्तदान्योन्यमाधावनगरं प्रति॥
en: They were also filled with a great fear of the Parthas. Looking at one another, all of them fled towards the city.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्येतच्छक्रवचनं निशम्य प्रतिगृह्य च। योधानामात्मनः सिद्धिमम्बरीषोऽभिपन्नवान्॥
en: Bhishma continued Hearing these words of Shakra and approving of them, king Ambarisha understood how warriors succeed in achieving success for themselves.

sa: न हायनैर्न पलितैर्न वित्तेन न बन्धुभिः॥ ऋषयश्चक्रिरे धर्म योऽनूचानः स नो महान्।
en: It is not age or decrepitude, of wealth or the number of kinsmen, by which the Rishis claim their mcrit. He only is great who is capable of reading and understanding the Vedas.'

sa: अभिगन्तुं महाप्राज्ञस्तीर्थान्यायतनानि च। स पूतिना विस्रवता वेदना” महामुनिः॥
en: That head thus sticking to his thigh, the greatly wise Brahmana could not (with ease), proceed to tirthas and other sacred places.

sa: वेदिर्यस्य त्वमित्राणां शिरोभ्यश्च प्रकीर्यते॥ अश्वस्कन्धैर्गजस्कन्धेस्तस्य लोका यथा मम।
en: That hero, whose altar is covered with the heads of foes, of horses, and of elephants, acquires regions of felicity like mine.

sa: ततस्तयोः संनिपातस्तुमुलो लोमहर्षणः॥ आसीदन्तकारो राजन् वैरस्य तव पुत्रयोः॥
en: Then that dreadful and hair-standing encounter took place between those two sons of yours O king, for terminating the long standing feud.

sa: अजिह्ममशठं मार्ग वर्तमानस्य भारत। सर्वदा सर्वभूतेषु ब्रह्माश्रमपदं भवेत्॥
en: That king, O Bharata, who always treats all creatures with fairness and sincerity, attains to the object of Vanaprastha mode of life.

sa: यौवनाश्वो यदाङ्गारं समरे प्रत्ययुध्यत। विस्फारैर्धनुषो देवा द्यौरभेदीति मेनिरे॥
en: When Yuvanashva's son fought in battle with Angara, the gods thought that the sky was breaking with the twang of his bow.

sa: इदं तु वचनं श्रुत्वा तव देवनियोगजम्। धारयिष्याम्यहं प्राणान् घटिष्ये न तु शोचितुम्॥
en: Hearing, however, these your words about what had been ordained by the gods, I shall not think of putting an end to my life and shall live and act without indulging in grief.'

sa: ब्राह्मणस्त्वब्रवीद् राजन् यस्मिन् काले क्षणो भवेत्। तदोपादेष्टुमिच्छामि यदाचयमनुत्तमम्॥
en: The Brahmana said,-O king when you may have leisure, I wish to listen to your instructions about that conduct which yields good!

sa: ततो बाणमयं जालं विततं पाण्डवोरसि॥ अपश्याम महाराज मेघजालमिवोद्गतम्।
en: We then, O king, beheld a net of arrows spread before the chest of Pandu's son like a mass of risen clouds.

sa: जनस्थाने शिरश्छिन्नं राक्षसस्य दुरात्मनः॥ क्षुरेण शितधारेण उत्पपात महावने।
en: At Janasthana he sundered the head of a wicked Rakshasa with highly sharp razorheaded arrow. That head dropped in the deep forest.

sa: यावदावेद्यते राज्ञे हतः कर्णोऽर्जुनेन वै। तावद्भवद्भिर्यत्तैस्तु भवितव्यं नराधिपैः॥
en: Stand you all here carefully, O kings, till we come back having communicated to the king the destruction of Karna by Arjuna.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा राजानं कृत्वा चाभिप्रदक्षिणम्। कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च द्रोणपुत्रश्च भारत॥ अवेक्षमाणा राजानं धृतराष्ट्रं मनीषिणम्। गङ्गामनु महाराज तूर्णमश्वानचोदयन्॥
en: Having said so to the king, and going round him, Kripa and Kritavarat man and Drona's son, O Bharata, without being able to take of men, son away their eyes from the wise king Dhritarashtra, urged their horses towards the banks of the Ganges.

sa: सेयं त्वामनुसम्प्राप्ता विक्रमेण वसुन्धरा। निर्जिताच महीपाला विक्रमेण त्वयानध॥
en: You have obtained the Earth through your prowess. All the kings have been defeated by you, O sinless one, through your prowess.

sa: दुर्योधनस्तु कौरव्यो नामर्षयत लङ्घनम्। प्रत्यषेधच्च तां कन्यामसत्कृत्य नराधिपान्॥
en: Duryodhana, however, of Kuru's race could not bear that insult of self. Disregarding all the kings, he ordered the maiden to stop.

sa: त्वां क्रोधवशमापन्नं विदित्वा भरतर्षभ। मयापकृष्टः कौन्तेयो मृत्योर्दष्ट्रान्तरं गतः॥
en: Knowing that you were filled with anger, O foremost of Bharata's race, I dragged Bhima away from within the jaws of Death.

sa: कर्णः शापाद् ब्रह्मक्षत्रान्तरे जातं सूतं मां विद्धि भार्गव॥ तमुवाच ततः भीतः प्रसादयन्।
en: Thus asked, Karna, fearing to be cursed, and trying to please him, said, O you of Bhrigu's race know me for a Suta, a race originating from the intermixture of Brahmanas with Kshatriyas.

sa: ततो ज्यातलनिर्घोषः पुनरासीद् विशाम्पते। प्रादुरासीच्छाराणां च सुमुक्तानां सुदारुणः॥
en: Again O king, the fierce twang of bows and the slapping of palms and the sound of arrows shot forcibly was heard.

sa: अष्टादश दिनान्यद्य युद्धस्यास्य जनार्दन।
en: Today is the eighteenth day, O Janarddana, of this great battle.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा चार्जुनोऽगच्छद् वासुदेवस्य पृष्ठतः। एवं संचेष्टमानांस्तानितश्चेतश्च भारत॥
en: Seeing this, Arjuna went behind Vasudeva, and the other sons of Pandu became restless and moved about from one place to another.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीन्महादेवः पचस्वैतानि सुव्रते॥ इत्युक्ता साऽपचत् तानि ब्राह्मणप्रियकाम्यया। ा
en: Mahadeva replied-Cook these jujubes, O you of excellent vows. After these words, she began to cook those jujubes for pleasing that Brahmana,

sa: सोऽहं भृगोः सुदयितां भार्यामपहरं बलात्। महर्षेरभिशापेन कृमिभूतोऽपतं भुवि।॥
en: I ravished the dearly-loved wife that sage. Cursed by him I fell down on the Earth in the form of a worm.

sa: रुषगाह्मणो वृद्धस्तपोनित्यश्च भारत। देहन्यासे कृतमना विचिन्त्य बहुधा तदा॥
en: Rushangu, O Bharata, was an old Brahmana always devoted to penances. Determined to renounce his body, he thought for a long while.

sa: तस्मिन् गते महाशब्दः शरीरात् तस्य निर्ययौ। पृष्टश्चाह बलं विद्धि यतो वृत्तमहं ततः॥
en: After this one had left Prahlada, another being come out, giving vent to loud and deep cries. Addressed by Prahlada, he answered,-Know that I am Power. I live there where good works are.

sa: एवं चरस्व राज्यस्थो यदि श्रेय इहेच्छसि। अतोऽन्यथा नरपतिर्भयमृच्छत्यनुत्तमम्॥
en: Behave thus while ruling your kingdom if you wish to enjoy prosperity. The king that behaves otherwise is visited by great calamities.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। मार्जारस्य च संवादं न्यग्रोधे मूषिकस्य च॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old story of the conversation between a cat and mouse at the foot of a banian tree.

sa: वयः प्राप्य परिक्षित् तु वेदव्रतमवाप्य च॥ कृपाच्छारद्वताच्छूरः सर्वास्त्राण्युपपत्स्यते।
en: Coming of age and acquiring a knowledge of the Vedas, the heroic Parikshit, shall obtain all weapons from the son of Sharadvat.

sa: न वित्तेन न पारुष्यैर्न सान्त्वेन न च श्रुतैः। कोपाग्निः शाम्यते राजस्तोयाग्निरिव सागरे॥
en: Like the Aurvya fire within the waters of the ocean, the fire of enmity can never be put out by presents of riches, by display of prowess, by conciliation or by scriptural learning.

sa: ब्राह्मणाय च राज्ञे च सर्वाः परिददे प्रजाः। तस्य वृत्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि यच्च तस्योपजीवनम्॥
en: To the Brahmana and the Kshatriya he assigned (the protection of) all creatures. I shall tell you what the Vaishya's profession is and how he is to earn the means of his maintenance.

sa: सुरथन्तं ततः क्रुद्धमापतन्तं महारथम्॥ चुकोप समरे द्रौणिर्दण्डाहत इवोरगः।
en: Seeing the great car-warrior Suratha proceed towards him in anger the son of Drona was filled with range like a scorched snake.

sa: ततोऽभ्येत्यारुणां देवीं प्लावयामास वारिणा॥ सरस्वत्यारुणायाश्च पुण्योऽयं संगमो महान्।
en: The divine Sarasvati, repaired to the Aruna and overflowed it with her waters. This confluence of Sarasvati and Aruna is highly sacred!

sa: इत्युक्त्वा रथमास्थाय रौहिणेयः प्रतापवान्। श्वेताभ्रशिखराकारः प्रययौ द्वारकां प्रति॥
en: Having said these words, the brave son of Rohini, looking like a white cloud, got upon his chariot and went towards Dwaraka.

sa: यं पुरा व्यजनै रम्यैरुपवीजन्ति योषितः। तमद्य पक्षव्यजनैरुपवीजन्ति पक्षिणः॥
en: He who was formerly fanned with beautiful fans by fair damsels, is now fanned by (carnivorous) birds with flaps of their wings.

sa: धनिनः पूजयेन्नित्यं पानाच्छादनभोजनैः। वक्तव्य.शानुगृह्णीध्वं प्रजाः सह मयेति वै॥
en: The king should always honour his rich su.bjects and should say to them,-Do you, with me, advance the interests of the people!

sa: राष्ट्रे तु येऽनुजीवन्ति ये तु राज्ञोऽनुजीविनः॥ अमात्यानां च सर्वेषां मध्यस्थानां च सर्वशः। ये च त्वाभिप्रशंसेयुर्निन्देयुरथवा पुनः॥ सर्वान् सुपरिणीतांस्तान् कारयेथा युधिष्ठिर।
en: Amongst the virtuous and wise, amongst those who never retreat from battle, and those who do not live in your kingdom, those who depend on you, and those who are your ministers, as well as those who do not follow party, they who praise or blame you should never be disregarded by you, O Yudhishthira!

sa: एवं सुरद्विषोऽनेकान् बलवानाततायिनः। जघान समरे वीरः कार्तिकेयो महाबलः॥
en: In this way the heroic and powerful Kartikeya killed numberless enemies of the gods, highly powerful that came to fight with him.

sa: तत्तु कर्म तथा कुर्याद् येन श्लाध्येत संसदि। शीलं समासेनैतत् ते कथितं कुरुसत्तम॥
en: That act, on the other hand, should be done for which one may be lauded in society. O best of the Kurus, I have now told you briefly as to what conduct is.

sa: स त्वस्त्रतेजसी लोकांस्तापयन्ती व्यवस्थिते। महर्षी सहितौ तत्र दर्शयामासतुस्तदा॥ नारदः सर्वभूतात्मा भरतानां पितामहः। उभौ शमयितुं वीरौ भारद्वाजधनंजयौ॥
en: Seeing those two weapons consuming the three worlds, the two great Rishis, viz., Narada who is the soul of every creature, and Vyasa, the grandfather of all the Bharata princes, came there. The two Rishis tried to pacify the two heroes, Ashvatthaman and Dhananjaya.

sa: संहादयन्तश्च तथा निर्घाताश्चापतन् क्षितौ। यथान्तकालसमये सुघोराः स्युस्तथा नृप॥
en: Thunder-bolts, also, with tremendous noise, dropped upon the Earth. Everything looked terrible, O king, as on the day of the universal dissolution.

sa: कुरोश्च यजमानस्य कुरुक्षेत्रे महात्मनः॥ आजगाम महाभाग सरिच्छेष्ठा सरस्वती।
en: While, again the great Kuru was engaged in a sacrifice at Kurukshetra, that foremost of rivers, the highly sacred Sarasvati, came there.

sa: आगतं मे मित्रबलं प्रहरध्वमभीतवत्। सत्त्ववन्तोऽभिधावेयुः कुर्वन्तो भैरवान् रवान्॥
en: The strong amongst them should resist the enemy, loudly saying to their comrades, Fresh friends have arrived! Fearlessly strike at your enemies!

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नोऽपि पाञ्चाल्यः शिखण्डी च महारथः॥ नाकुलिस्तु शतानीको रथानीकमयोधयन्।
en: The Panchala prince Dhrishtadyumna and the great car-warrior Shikhandin and Shatanika the son of Nakula, fought with the car-division of the enemy.

sa: श्रुतिधर्म इति ह्येके नेत्याहुरपरे जनाः। न च तत्प्रत्यसूयामो न हि सर्वं विधीयते॥
en: Some say that Righteousness is the injunction of the Shrutis. Others do not agree to this. I would into blame them that say so. Everything, again, has not been described in the Shrutis.

sa: तानापतत एवाशु पूरयाणान् रथस्वनैः। दिशश्च विदिशश्चैव कम्पयानांश्च मेदिनीम्॥ प्रतिजग्राह समरे सेनापतिरमित्रजित्। युधिष्ठिरं त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा भीमसेनं च पञ्चभिः॥
en: That vanquisher of foes, the commander of the Kuru army, received in that battle all those heroes that rushed towards him vehemently filling the cardinal and the subsidiary points of the compass with the rattle of their cars and causing the Earth to tremble.

sa: कदाचित् तं जलस्थायं मत्स्यबन्धाः समन्ततः। निस्त्रावयामासुरथो निम्नेषु विविधैर्मुखैः॥
en: One day certain fishermen came to that lake and began to draw out its waters to a lower ground through various channels,

sa: अपि चोशनसा गीतः श्रूयतेऽयं पुरातनः। श्लोकस्तत्त्वार्थसहितस्तन्मे निगदतः शृणु॥
en: We have all heard the old verse uttered by Ushanas, Hear I recite it to you with its true sense and meaning!

sa: अटन् भैक्ष्यं न विन्दामि यदा युष्माकमालये॥ तदा बुद्धिः कृता पापे हरिष्यामि श्वजाघनीम्।
en: After I had failed to secure any alms, having wandered from house to house in this your hamlet, I determined to perpetrate this sinful act of taking away this haunch of dog's meat.

sa: हयानन्ये गजानन्ये स्थानन्ये महारथाः। आरुह्य जवसम्पन्नाः पदातीन् प्रजहुर्भयात्॥
en: Thus fled away in fear all the great carwarriors some on cars, some on horses, some on elephants and some on foot.

sa: अनृतस्यावमन्तारो वक्तारो जनसंसदि। चरन्ति वसुधां कृत्स्नां वावदूका बहुश्रुताः॥
en: Those wicked men, though highly learned, travel all over the Earth, delivering lectures in assemblies, and deprecating the true doctrine about liberation.

sa: दुर्योधनो युधां श्रेष्ठ आहवे केशवार्जुनौ। समभ्ययादुग्रतेजाः शरैश्चाप्यहनद् बली॥
en: That foremost of warriors, the energetic Duryodhana, rushed in that battle, against Keshava and Arjuna and struck them both with many arrows.

sa: उह्यमानांश्च कृष्णेन वायुनेव बलाहकाः। जाम्बूनदविचित्राङ्गा वहन्ते चार्जुनं रणे॥
en: Urged on by Krishna, like masses of clouds driven by the wind and decked with golden trappings, they hear Arjuna to battle.

sa: कर्णं तु शूरं पतितं पृथिव्यां शराचितं शोणितदिग्धगात्रम्। यद्दच्छया सूर्यमिवावनिस्थं दिदृक्षवः सम्परिवार्य तस्थुः॥
en: For seeing the brave Karna, wounded with shafts and bathed in blood lying prostrate on earth like the sun dropped from the sky the warriors came there and stood encircling the fallen hero.

sa: पश्य तेषां कृपणतां पश्य तेषामबुद्धिताम्। अध्रुवे जीविते मोहादर्थदृष्टिमुपाश्रिताः॥
en: Mark at their pitiable condition! Witness their foolishness! When life is so short and uncertain, these men, actuated by ignorance, seek wealth.

sa: हयानीकेन महता सौबलश्चापि संवृतः॥ प्रययौ सर्वसैन्येन कैतव्यश्च महारथः।
en: Surrounded by a large army of cavalry and other troops, Subala's son, Sakuni, as also the great car-warrior, Uluka, proceeded with others.

sa: जातरूपप्रतिच्छन्नां प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्॥ अवधीत् तावकान् योधान् दण्डपाणिरिवान्तकः।
en: Taking up his massive mace adorned with gold, he began to kill your soldiers like the destroyer himself armed with his club.

sa: शरीरमेव सृजतः पिता माता च भारत॥ आचार्यशिष्टा या जातिः सा दिव्या साजरामरा।
en: The father and the mother, O Bharata, only create the body. The life, on the other hand, which one acquires from his preceptor, is divine. That life suffers no decays and is imimortal.

sa: तप्तहेममयैः शुभैर्बभूव भयवर्धिनी। अग्निज्वालैरिवाबद्धा पट्टैः शल्यस्य सा गदा॥
en: The mace of Shalya, coated with a shining cloth of gold that looked like a sheet of fire, made the on-lookers afraid.

sa: प्रजाः पालयतोऽसभ्यगधर्मेणेह भूपतेः। हार्द भयं सम्भवति स्वर्गश्चास्य विरुद्ध्यते॥
en: If a king governs his subjects unfairly, fear takes possession of his heart and the door of heaven is shut against him.

sa: ये सपत्नाः सपत्नानां सर्वोस्तानुपसेवयेत्। आत्मनश्चापि बोद्धव्याचारा विनिहताः परैः॥
en: The king should always honour the enemies of his foes. He should consider his own spies as agents employed by his enemies,

sa: ब्राह्मणेभ्योऽतिरिक्तं च भुञ्जीरनितरे जनाः। न ब्राह्मणापराधेन हरेदन्यः कथंचन॥
en: The residue, after supporting the Brahmanas, should be devoted to the support of other people, Nobody should take by inuring the Brahmanas.

sa: अश्वत्थामा कृपश्चैव त्रिगर्ताधिपतिस्तथा। उलूकः शकुनिश्चैव कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः॥
en: There remain also Ashvatthaman and Kripa and the king of the Trigartas and Uluka and Shakuni and Kritavarman of the Satwata race.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा पृष्ठमारुह्य वाजिनः। अपाक्रामद्धतरथो नातिदूरमरिंदमः॥ ते
en: Then that grinder of foes, viz., king Duryodhana, having thus lost his car, rode on horseback and retreated to a little distance.

sa: पाण्डवानां विनाशाय मा ते बुद्धिः कदाचन। शक्ता चासि महाभागे पृथिवीं सचराचराम्॥ चक्षुषा क्रोधदीप्तेन निर्दग्धुं तपसो बलात्।
en: Let not your heart be bent towards the destruction of the Pandavas. On account of the power of your penances, you are able, O highly blessed one, to consume with your cyes, burning in anger, the whole Earth with her mobile and immobile creatures.'

sa: राजधर्मान् विशेषेण कथयस्व पितामह। सर्वस्य जीवलोकस्य राजधर्मः परायणम्॥
en: O grandfather, do you speak fully on the duties of kings. The science of royal duties is the refuge of all creatures.

sa: याबद्धि पृथिवीपाल पृथ्वीयं स्थास्यति ध्रुवा। तावत् तत्तवाक्षया कीर्तिर्लोकाननुचरिष्यति॥
en: As long, O king, as the Earth will last, so long will your fame travel with unmitigated lustre through all the worlds.

sa: अल्पोऽप्यतिक्रमो नास्ति पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्॥ धर्मतो न्यायतश्चैव स्नेहतश्च परंतप।
en: Judged by the standard of Ethics or reason or affection, the Pandavas have not committed the slightest offense, O scorcher of foes.

sa: तयोः समभवद् युद्धं घोररूपमसंवृतम्। गदानिपातै राजेन्द्र तक्षतोः परस्परम्॥
en: When, O king, by the repeated falls of their maces, they wounded each other, the battle became exceedingly dreadful and perfectly unrestrained.

sa: दुर्योधनस्तु पार्थेन विवरे सम्प्रदर्शिते। ईषदुन्मिषमाणस्तु सहसा प्रससार ह॥
en: During the onset of the fight, when : Vrikodara, seemed to give Duryodhana an opportunity, the latter, smiling a little, advanced forward.

sa: यथा तु पुरुषो राजन् दीर्घमध्वानमास्थितः। क्वचित् क्वचिच्छ्रमाच्छ्रान्तः कुरुते वासमेव वा॥ एवं संसारपर्याये गर्भवासेषु भारत। कुर्वन्ति दुर्बुधा वासं मुच्यन्ते तत्र पण्डिताः॥
en: As a person, O king, who has to travel a long distance, is sometimes obliged to halt for being fatigued so, O Bharata, they that are of little understanding traveling along the long way of life, have to make frequent halts in the shape of repeated births. The wise are, however, freed from that obligation.

sa: रथान् सप्तशतान् हत्वा कुरूणामाततायिनाम्। याण्डवाः सह पञ्चालैः पुनरेवाभ्यवारयन्॥
en: Killing those seven hundred hostile carwarriors of the Kuru army, the Pandavas and the Panchalas once more resisted (the whole Kuru ariny).

sa: तमब्रवीन्महाराज पुत्रस्तव विशाम्पते॥ ममाज्ञया द्विजश्रेष्ठ द्रोणपुत्रोऽभिषिच्यताम्। सैनापत्येन भद्रं ते मम चेदिच्छसि प्रियम्॥
en: Your son then, O king, said to Kripa-'Let the son of Drona, O foremost of Brahmanas, blessed by you, if you wish to do me good, be, at my command, appointed as generalissimo.

sa: विकीर्णारिवादित्यो भीष्मः शरशतैश्चितः। शुशुभे परया लक्ष्या वृतो ब्राह्मणसत्तमैः॥
en: Surrounded by many foremost of Brahmanas, that hero, his body cut with innumerable arrows, shone like the sun with his innumerable rays.

sa: ततः शरशतैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मद्रराजो महारथः। अर्दयामास तां सेनां धर्मराजस्य पश्यतः॥
en: The powerful king of the Madras struck that army with showers of keen arrows before the very eyes of the righteous king.

sa: स तं विदित्वा ब्रह्मर्षिर्यममागतमोजसा। प्राञ्जलिः प्रयतो भूत्वा उपविष्टस्तपोधनः॥
en: Understanding that it was Yama who had come, the twice-born quickly saluted him and sat with closed hands in an attentive attitude,

sa: गोभिः समुद्रेण तथा गोलाकुलर्भवानरैः। गुप्ता रामभयोद्विग्नाः क्षत्रियाणां कुलोद्वहाः॥
en: The sons of Kshatriyas, stricken with the fear of Rama, were concealed (and brought up) by kine, Ocean, pards, bears, and monkeys.

sa: पुनश्च जवमास्थाय जवनो मृगयूथपः। अतीत्यातीत्य राजेन्द्र पुनरभ्येति चान्तिकम्॥
en: Repeatedly showing its quickness and crossing one forest after another, it now and then appeared before the king at a near point.

sa: सोऽस्मि जात: कुले श्रेष्ठे ब्राह्मणानां सुपूजिते। मन्दभाग्यतयास्म्येतं क्षत्रधर्ममनुष्ठितः॥
en: I am born in a worshipful and high family of Brahmanas. Through ill-luck, however, I am loading the life of a Kshatriya.

sa: स गङ्गामभिसंगम्य नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणः प्रभुः। गर्भमाहितवान् दिव्यं भास्करोपमतेजसम्॥
en: At the behest of Brahma, the lord Agni, approaching the river Ganga, threw into her that divine seed effulgent like the Sun.

sa: हविःश्वा प्रलिहेद् दृष्ट्वा दण्डश्चेन्नोद्यतो भवेत्। हरेत् काकः पुरोडाशं यदि दण्डो न पालयेत्॥
en: If the rod of chastisement be not taken up, the dog will lick the sacrificial butter. If that rod were not raised up, the crow also would take away the first (sacrificial) offering.

sa: सभायां क्लिश्यमानस्य धार्तराष्ट्रैर्दुरात्मभिः॥ सहसोत्पतितः क्रोधः कर्णं दृष्ट्वा प्रशाम्यति।
en: Whilst I was tormented in the court by the wicked sons of Dhritarashtra, my anger suddenly excited, became cooled on seeing Karma.

sa: शब्दश्च तुमुल: संख्ये शराणां पततामभूत्। महावेणुवनस्येव दह्यमानस्य पर्वते॥
en: Loud noise, of the falling shafts in that battle, resembled that of a vast forest of bamboo's while burning on every side.

sa: शब्दश्च तुमुल: संख्ये शराणां पततामभूत्। महावेणुवनस्येव दह्यमानस्य पर्वते॥
en: Loud noise, of the falling shafts in that battle, resembled that of a vast forest of bamboo's while burning on every side.

sa: विश्वं हि ब्रह्म सुमहच्चरौ तव समाहितम्॥ क्षत्रवीर्यं च सकलं तव मात्रे समर्पितम्।
en: The seed of the supreme and universal Brahma had been placed into the sanctified food intended for you, while into that intended for your mother had been placed the sum-total of Kshatriya energy.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा तां भार्यां सर्चीको भृगुनन्दनः। तपस्यभिरतः श्रीमाजगामारण्यमेव हि॥
en: Having said these words to his wife, the blessed Richika of Bhrigu's race, setting his heart on penances, entered into the woods.

sa: अभिगम्य तु योगेन भक्ति भीष्मस्य माधवः। त्रैलोक्यदर्शनं ज्ञानं दिव्यं दत्त्वा ययौ हरिः॥
en: Learning by his Yoga power of the devotion of Bhishma, Madhava, called also Hari, (entering his body) conferred upon him divine knowledge of the Past, the Present, and the Future, and went away.

sa: ततः स राजा सर्वेभ्यो द्विजेभ्यः पुरुषर्षभ। आचचक्षे यथान्यायं परिचर्यां च भारत॥ हैहयानां, कुले जातः सुमित्रो मित्रनन्दनः। चरामि मृगयूथानि निनन् बाणैः सहस्रशः॥ बलेन महता गुप्तः सामात्यः सावरोधनः। मृगस्तु विद्धो बाणेन मया सरति शल्यवान्॥
en: Thus addressed, O foremost of men, the king described himself, O Bharata, saying.-I am born in the family of the Haihayas. My name is Sumitra, and I am the son of Mitra. I chase herds of deer, killing them in thousands with my shafts. Accompanied by a large army and my ministers and the ladies of my household, I have come out ahunting. I struck a deer with a shaft, but the animal with the arrow shaft, but the animal with arrow sticking to his body ran speedily.

sa: धनंजयो रथानीकमभ्यवर्तत वीर्यवान्। माद्रीपुत्रौ च शकुनिं सात्यक्श्चि महारथः॥
en: Then Dhananjaya proceeded against the car-division of the foe. The two sons of Madri and the great car-warrior Satyaki proceeded against Shakuni.

sa: मत्ता इव महानागा विनदन्तो मुहुर्मुहुः। सुभीमा घोररूपाश्च शूलपटिशपाणयः॥
en: Terrible, and armed with lances and battleaxes, they were clad in robes of various colours and decked with beautiful garlands and unguents.

sa: एकाकी बहुभिस्तत्र परिवार्य महारथैः। अधर्मेण नरव्याघ्रो भीमसेनेन पातितः॥
en: The king was all alone in the midst of a great number of powerful car-warriors cumstances was that king killed by Bhimasena.

sa: उपेक्षितव्यो यत्नेन तादृशः पुरुषाधमः। यद् यद् ब्रूयादल्पमतिस्तत्तदस्य सहेद्बुधः॥
en: Such a wretched wight should carefully be disregarded. The wise man should endure every thing that such a foolish person may say.

sa: अथयोऽधर्मतः पाति राजामात्योऽथ वाऽऽत्मजः। धर्मासने संनियुक्तो धर्ममूले नरर्षभ॥ कार्येष्वधिकृताः सम्यगकुर्वन्तो नृपानुगाः। आत्मानं पुरतः कृत्वा यान्त्यधः सहपार्थिवाः॥
en: A kingdom, O foremost of men, depends upon righteousness. That minister, or king's son, who acts unfairly, holding the seat of justice, and those officers who, having accepted responsible offices, act unjustly, actuated by self-interest, all sink in hell along with the king himself.

sa: तदद्भुतमचिन्त्यं च भेदनं धनुषस्तथा। तच्छ्रुत्वाहमनुप्राप्तो धनुर्गृह्यापरं शुभम्॥ तदिदं घोरसंकाशं जामदग्न्यं महदनुः। पूरयस्व शरेणैव स्वबलं दर्शयस्व च॥
en: Having heard of that wonderful and inconceivable breaking of the bow, I have bent my steps hither. Do you take another auspicious bow,. Do you stretch it, fix the arrow upon this mighty and dreadful bow, belonging to Jamadagni; and thus display your prowess.

sa: ततो गृध्रस्य वचनात् सम्पातेर्हनुमान् बली। शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं पुप्लुवे लवणार्णवम्॥
en: Then at the suggestion of the vulture Sampāti, the mighty Hanuman crossed the salt sea extending for a hundred Yojanas (900 miles).

sa: ततः सुग्रीवसहितो गत्वा तीरं महोदधेः। समुद्र क्षोभयामास शरैरादित्यसंनिभैः॥
en: Thereafter accompanied by Sugrīva, Rāma repaired to the shore of the mighty ocean, and with shafts resembling the sun, vexed the deep.

sa: शिष्यस्तु तस्य ब्रुवतो मुनेर्वाक्यमनुत्तमम्। प्रतिजग्राह संतुष्टस्तस्य तुष्टोऽभवन्मुनि ॥
en: When the sage had spoken thus, his disciple, well pleased, assented to his excellent speech; and thereat that pious person was gratified.

sa: ततः कदाचित् तं देशमाजगाम यदृच्छया। विभाण्डकसुतस्तत्र ताश्चपश्यद् वराङ्गनाः॥
en: It came to pass that on one occasion, walking about at will, Vibhandaka's son came to that spot and beheld the courtezans.

sa: श्वेताभ्रघनराजीव वायुपुत्रानुगामिनी। तस्य सा शुशुभे छाया पतिता लवणाम्भसि॥
en: That shadow resembling masses of white clouds, rallying on the salt waters and following the wind-god's son, seemed exceedingly beautiful. on more

sa: कपिवातश्च बलवान् मेघवातश्च निर्गतः। सागरं भीमनिर्हादं कम्पयामासतु शम्॥
en: And the wind begot of the monkey as well as that of the clouds, issuing out, made the dreadsounding ocean roll violently.

sa: मारुतस्यौरसः श्रीमान् हनूमान् नाम वानरः। वज्रसंहननोपेतो वैनतेयसमो जवे॥
en: And the Wind-god beget the graceful monkey named Hanumān, endued with a frame hard as adamant; in fleetness like to Vinatā's offspring.

sa: ब्राह्मणान् भोजयामास पौरजानपदानपि। अददद् ब्राह्मणानां च रत्नौघममलं बहु॥
en: And the king fed the Brāhmaṇas as well as the inhabitants rural and urban; and he bestowed heaps of jewels upon Brāhmaṇas.

sa: तेऽपि पुत्राः कृशाश्वस्य प्रजापतिसुतासुताः। नैकरूपा महावीर्या दीप्तिमन्तो जयावहाः॥
en: Those sons of Krśāśva were the offspring of Prajāpati's daughters. And they were endowed with various forms, and were effulgent and dreadful.

sa: सुन्दे तु निहते राम अगस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम्। ताटका सहपुत्रेण प्रधर्षयितुमिच्छति॥
en: O Rāma, when Sunda had been destroyed, Tat akā along with her son, set her heart upon afflicting that excellent saint Agastya.

sa: स दृष्ट्वा स्वां तनुं पक्षरुद्तैररुणच्छदैः॥ प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे वानरांश्चेदमब्रवीत्।
en: Thereupon, seeing his person furnished with grown pinions hued like the infant sun, he experienced incomparable raptures, and addressed the monkeys, saying,

sa: अहं हि नियमाद् राम हित्वा तां समुपागतः। सिद्धाश्रममनुप्राप्तः सिद्धोऽस्मि तव तेजसा ॥
en: And, O Rama, it is only for the purpose of completing my sacrifice that leaving her behind, I have come to Siddhāśrama. And now by virtue of your energy, have I attained fruition.

sa: तां दृष्ट्वा पुण्यसलिलां हंससारससेविताम्। बभूवुर्मुनयः सर्वे मुदिताः सहराघवाः॥
en: Having beheld that river furnished with sacred waters, and frequented by swans and cranes, the ascetics who accompanied Rāghava were exceedingly delighted.

sa: निक्षिप्तमात्रे गर्भे तु तेजोभिरभिरञ्जितम्। सर्वं पर्वतसंनद्धं सौवर्णमभवद् वनम्॥
en: As soon as the embryo was brought forth, the woods adjoining the mountain, being overspread with that energy, were turned into gold.

sa: सुमतिस्तु नरव्याघ्र गर्भतुम्बं व्यजायत। षष्ठिः पुत्रसहस्राणि तुम्बभेदाद् विनिःसृताः॥
en: And Sumati, O foremost of men, brought forth a gourd. And when it burst open, out came from it sixty thousand sons.

sa: खन्यमाने ततस्तस्मिन् ददृशुः पर्वतोपमम्। दिशागजं विरूपाक्षं धारयन्तं महीतलम्॥
en: And as they were engaged in excavating, they beheld the elephant of the quarter resembling a hill, named Virūpākṣa, holding the earth.

sa: स चात्र तप आतष्ठिदहल्यासहितः पुरा। वर्षपूगान्यनेकानि राजपुत्र महायशः॥
en: Here, O illustrious prince, in days of yore Gautama in company with Ahalyā carried on austerities for a long series of years.

sa: प्राज्वलद् ब्रह्मदण्डश्च वसिष्ठस्य करोद्यतः। विधूम इव कालाग्नेर्यमदण्ड इवापरः॥
en: And resembling another staff of Yama, the Brahmā staff raised by Vasiştha's arm flamed like to the fire at the universal dissolution.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा हनुमांस्तत्र चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बराम्। अब्रवीत् तां महाभागां तापसी धर्मचारिणीम्॥
en: Having said this to that female clad in a piece of black deer-skin, Hanumān asked that highly religious ascetic practising pious offices,

sa: मौनं वर्षसहस्रस्य कृत्वा व्रतमनुत्तमम्। चकाराप्रतिमं राम तपः परमदुष्करम्॥
en: Adopting the high vow of taciturnity for a thousand years, he, O Rāma began to perform the most signal and arduous austerities.

sa: दिष्ट्या मे निर्जिता विघ्ना दिष्ट्या मे पूजितं कुलम्।।११ राघवैः सह सम्बन्धाद् वीर्यश्रेष्ठर्महाबलैः।
en: By luck it is that I have overcome the obstacle; by luck it is that my race has attained renown, in consequence of alliance with those endowed with prowess, the exceedingly potent Rāghavas.

sa: सोऽपि तान्वानरान्सर्वान्नष्टाः स्थेत्यब्रवीत् बली॥ अभ्यधावत संक्रुद्धो मुष्टिमुद्यम्य संगतम्।
en: And that strong one also, saying to the monkeys, Destroyed are you, and uplifting his clenched fist, rushed after them in rage.

sa: एतावज्जीवलोकस्य भास्करो रजनीक्षये। कृत्वा वितिमिरं सर्वमस्तं गच्छति पर्वतम्॥
en: On the departure of night, the sun dispels the darkness of the world to this extent, and then enters the Setting hill.

sa: तच्छुत्वा शोकसंतप्ता संतापयसि मां भृशम्। आविष्टासि गृहे शून्ये सा त्वं परवशं गता॥
en: Now hearing of the installation of Rāma, you yourself filled with grief, are making me exceedingly aggrieved. Or in this empty chamber having been possessed, you have come under influence not your own.

sa: तत्र नेत्रमन:क्रान्तः कुञ्जरो नाम पर्वतः॥ अगस्त्यभवनं यत्र निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा। तत्र योजनविस्तारमुच्छ्रितं दशयोजनम्॥ शरणं काञ्चनं दिव्यं नानारत्नविभूषितम्।
en: There is the hill named Kunjara, grateful both to the eye and the mind, where Viśvakarmā had built the abode of Agastya*. There (rises) that stately golden pile, adorned with various gems, extending over one Yojana, and ten in height. *i.e. in that hill.

sa: महेन्द्रसद्मप्रतिमं च वेश्म रामस्य रम्यं मृगपक्षिजुष्टम्। ददर्श मेरोरिव शृङ्गमुच्चं विभ्राजमानं प्रभया सुमन्त्रः॥ उपस्थितैरञ्जलिकारिभिश्च सोपायनैर्जानपदैर्जनैश्च। कोट्या परार्धेश्च विमुक्तयानैः समाकुलं द्वारपदं ददर्श॥
en: He saw the pleasant abode of Rāma, resembling that of Mahendra, and filled with deers and birds, having its top high as the summit of Meru and situated well in splendour, and the gateway filled with millions of citizens with clasped hands keeping their conveyances outside and coming from various quarters with presents for Rāma.

sa: किं जीवितेनेह विना त्वया मे लोकेन वा किं स्वधयामृतेन। श्रेयो मुहूर्तं तव संनिधानं ममेव कृत्स्नादपि जीवलोकात्॥
en: Without you, of what avail to me is my life, my relatives, the worship of the manes and the deities and the knowledge of divine truth on this earth? Prefer do I your company even for a moment to the presence of all creation.
